rec_sblade.name: Spore Blade
rec_sblade.description: +15% AD. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_sbow.name: Spore Wing
rec_sbow.description: +12% AS. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_srod.name: Spore Wand
rec_srod.description: +15 AP. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_stear.name: Spore Drop
rec_stear.description: +15 mana. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_svest.name: Spore Vest
rec_svest.description: +20 armor. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_scloak.name: Spore Mantle
rec_scloak.description: +20 MR. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_sbelt.name: Spore Belt
rec_sbelt.description: +150 HP. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_sglove.name: Spore Gloves
rec_sglove.description: +10% crit, +8% dodge. Dark Spore component: combined with any component it makes the Shadow version of the item.

rec_egg.name: Digi-Egg
rec_egg.description: Combine with a component to make a Crest (Spore components make the rarer Crests), or with another Digi-Egg for +1 team size.

rec_s_victory_sword.name: Ruin Sword
rec_s_victory_sword.description: Deals 15% more damage. Each knockout gives +20% attack damage. Drawback: 15% less max HP.

rec_r_victory_sword.name: Luminous Sword
rec_r_victory_sword.description: Deals 20% more damage. Each knockout gives +20% attack damage.

rec_s_titan_slayer.name: Spectral Slayer
rec_s_titan_slayer.description: Deals 50% more damage to enemies with 1100 or more max HP. Drawback: no bonus against smaller enemies.

rec_r_titan_slayer.name: Demon Slayer
rec_r_titan_slayer.description: Deals 30% more damage, and 40% more on top to enemies with 1600 or more max HP.

rec_s_gunblade.name: Mercy Gunblade
rec_s_gunblade.description: Magic damage the holder deals heals the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of it. Drawback: the holder heals nothing from it.

rec_r_gunblade.name: Lifeblade
rec_r_gunblade.description: Heals for 40% of all damage dealt.

rec_s_mana_lance.name: Spectral Lance
rec_s_mana_lance.description: Basic attacks restore 14 extra mana. Drawback: deals 10% less damage.

rec_s_guardian_feather.name: Fallen Feather
rec_s_guardian_feather.description: The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with 70% max HP. Drawback: after that it has 50% less attack speed.

rec_r_guardian_feather.name: Archangel Feather
rec_r_guardian_feather.description: The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with full HP.

rec_s_blood_fang.name: Risk Fang
rec_s_blood_fang.description: Heals for 40% of damage dealt. Each time it heals back above 90% HP, it gains 40% attack speed for 4 seconds. Drawback: starts combat at 80% HP.

rec_r_blood_fang.name: Blessed Fang
rec_r_blood_fang.description: Heals for 50% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 40% max HP shield once.

rec_s_war_banner.name: Bleak Banner
rec_s_war_banner.description: At the start of combat, allies next to the holder in the same row lose 20% attack speed, and the holder gains 35% attack speed for each of them. Drawback: slows those allies.

rec_r_war_banner.name: Harmony Banner
rec_r_war_banner.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 45% attack speed and 10% omnivamp.

rec_s_crit_edge.name: Sacrifice Edge
rec_s_crit_edge.description: Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 2% of its max HP.

rec_r_crit_edge.name: Zenith Edge
rec_r_crit_edge.description: Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Abilities can critically strike.

rec_s_rapid_cannon.name: Rapid Deathcannon
rec_s_rapid_cannon.description: +1 attack range. Gains 75% attack speed while no enemy is within 2 hexes. Drawback: no flat attack speed bonus.

rec_r_rapid_cannon.name: Light Cannon
rec_r_rapid_cannon.description: +2 attack range and a lot of attack speed.

rec_s_rage_wing.name: Blood Rage Wing
rec_s_rage_wing.description: Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 1.5% of its max HP.

rec_r_rage_wing.name: Reckoning Wing
rec_r_rage_wing.description: Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking.

rec_s_volt_disk.name: Volt Stiletto
rec_s_volt_disk.description: Every 2nd basic attack sends lightning to 4 enemies for 80 magic damage. Drawback: 30% less attack damage.

rec_r_volt_disk.name: Volt Favor
rec_r_volt_disk.description: Every 3rd basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 160 magic damage.

rec_s_titan_will.name: Titan Revenge
rec_s_titan_will.description: Stores 60% of the damage the holder takes. Every 2 seconds its next basic attack releases the store as true damage. Drawback: no stacking stats.

rec_r_titan_will.name: Titan Vow
rec_r_titan_will.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times.

rec_s_twin_shot.name: Wild Twin Shot
rec_s_twin_shot.description: Basic attacks also hit 2 more nearby enemies for 70% damage. Drawback: 10% less attack damage.

rec_r_twin_shot.name: Twin Tempest
rec_r_twin_shot.description: Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for full damage.

rec_s_void_portal.name: Unstable Portal
rec_s_void_portal.description: Like Void Portal, but the Voidlarva deals 250 true damage to enemies next to it when it falls. Drawback: 10% less max HP.

rec_r_void_portal.name: Void Invitation
rec_r_void_portal.description: At the start of combat, a Voidlarva rises next to the holder and enemies within 3 hexes target it. When the holder is knocked out, another rises.

rec_s_armor_breaker.name: Final Whisper
rec_s_armor_breaker.description: Critical strikes cut the target's armor and magic resist by 70% for 5 seconds. Drawback: the holder has 20% less armor and magic resist.

rec_r_armor_breaker.name: Eternal Whisper
rec_r_armor_breaker.description: Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 70% for 3 seconds.

rec_s_ultima_wand.name: Caustic Wand
rec_s_ultima_wand.description: A huge amount of ability power. Drawback: 15% less max HP.

rec_r_ultima_wand.name: Ascended Wand
rec_r_ultima_wand.description: An enormous amount of ability power.

rec_s_seraph_staff.name: Undying Staff
rec_s_seraph_staff.description: Each cast grants max HP equal to 3.5 times the holder's max mana and heals that much. Drawback: no ability power gain.

rec_r_seraph_staff.name: Holy Staff
rec_r_seraph_staff.description: Each cast grants ability power equal to 60% of the holder's max mana.

rec_s_iron_locket.name: Lunar Locket
rec_s_iron_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 60 armor and magic resist. Drawback: they gain 5 less mana per basic attack.

rec_r_iron_locket.name: Prime Locket
rec_r_iron_locket.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 3 hexes in the same row gain a 450 shield (600 Champion form, 750 final form) and 200 max HP.

rec_s_mana_zap.name: Dark Spark
rec_s_mana_zap.description: When any other Digimon within 2 hexes casts, it is zapped: enemies take twice their max mana as magic damage, allies half their max mana. The holder gains 10 AP per zap. Drawback: zaps allies too.

rec_r_mana_zap.name: Covalent Spark
rec_r_mana_zap.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 400 magic damage. Regenerates 1% max HP per second.

rec_s_flame_tome.name: Evil Tome
rec_s_flame_tome.description: Magic damage curses the target: 6% of its max HP as true damage per second for 8 seconds, and less healing. Drawback: the holder's other magic damage is 20% lower.

rec_r_flame_tome.name: Radiant Tome
rec_r_flame_tome.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing. Deals 20% more damage.

rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.name: Sacrifice Gauntlet
rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +50% crit damage, and +25% crit chance after the first cast. Drawback: each cast costs HP equal to half the max mana times the form (1, 2, 3).

rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.name: Glamor Gauntlet
rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +90% crit damage.

rec_s_mana_overflow.name: Dark Overflow
rec_s_mana_overflow.description: After casting, keeps 50 mana while below 60% HP. Drawback: only 20 mana above 60% HP, and max mana is not lowered.

rec_r_mana_overflow.name: Blue Blessing
rec_r_mana_overflow.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keeps 30 mana.

rec_s_frost_heart.name: Frozen Dark Heart
rec_s_frost_heart.description: Enemies within 2 hexes have 35% less attack speed. Drawback: allies next to the holder have 25% less attack speed too.

rec_r_frost_heart.name: Frost Heart of Gold
rec_r_frost_heart.description: Enemies within 2 hexes have 50% less attack speed.

rec_s_power_chalice.name: Malice Chalice
rec_s_power_chalice.description: At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 45 ability power. Drawback: the holder loses 20 ability power.

rec_r_power_chalice.name: Charity Chalice
rec_r_power_chalice.description: At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 50 ability power and 10% omnivamp.

rec_s_holy_ring.name: Sacrifice Ring
rec_s_holy_ring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals every other ally for 25% of its missing HP. Drawback: each time, the holder loses 5% of its current HP.

rec_r_holy_ring.name: Radiant Ring
rec_r_holy_ring.description: Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second.

rec_s_justice_hand.name: Vengeance Hand
rec_s_justice_hand.description: Gains 30% attack damage, 30 ability power and 20% omnivamp. Drawback: these switch off after each knockout the holder scores and come back on the next one.

rec_r_justice_hand.name: Fairness Fist
rec_r_justice_hand.description: Deals 20% more damage and heals for 20% of damage dealt.

rec_s_spike_plate.name: Refracted Plate
rec_s_spike_plate.description: A huge amount of armor. Drawback: no spikes.

rec_r_spike_plate.name: Rosethorn Plate
rec_r_spike_plate.description: When attacked, deals 200 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown). Regenerates 2% max HP per second.

rec_s_stone_hide.name: Undying Stone
rec_s_stone_hide.description: Every 2 seconds, heals 2% max HP for each enemy within 2 hexes. Drawback: no armor or magic resist from nearby enemies.

rec_r_stone_hide.name: Dvarapala Stone
rec_r_stone_hide.description: Gains 20 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes. Regenerates 2% max HP per second.

rec_s_flame_core.name: Eclipse Core
rec_s_flame_core.description: Every 1.5 seconds, burns a random enemy within 3 hexes. Drawback: the holder burns itself for the first 5 seconds.

rec_r_flame_core.name: Sunlight Core
rec_r_flame_core.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes, and every 1.5 seconds a random enemy within 4 hexes. Regenerates 0.5% max HP per second.

rec_s_still_shroud.name: Dark Shroud
rec_s_still_shroud.description: At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column need 80% more mana for their first cast. Drawback: allies in that column need 40% more.

rec_r_still_shroud.name: Reverent Shroud
rec_r_still_shroud.description: At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns next to it need 50% more mana for their first cast. Allies start with 15 more mana.

rec_s_dragon_scale.name: Refracted Scale
rec_s_dragon_scale.description: Takes 20% less magic damage, and critical strikes deal no extra damage to the holder. Drawback: no extra magic resist.

rec_r_dragon_scale.name: Dragon Will
rec_r_dragon_scale.description: A huge amount of magic resist. Regenerates 2% max HP per second.

rec_s_wind_ward.name: Turbulent Ward
rec_s_wind_ward.description: At the start of combat, the enemy facing the holder across the board is stunned for 7 seconds, even if immune. Drawback: it then gains 30% attack damage and 30 ability power.

rec_r_wind_ward.name: Mistral Ward
rec_r_wind_ward.description: At the start of combat, the enemy facing the holder across the board is stunned for 6 seconds, even if immune, and your team gains 10% attack speed.

rec_s_quick_silver.name: Caustic Silver
rec_s_quick_silver.description: Immune to stuns for the whole combat. Drawback: 12% less max HP.

rec_r_quick_silver.name: Quickest Silver
rec_r_quick_silver.description: Immune to stuns for the first 30 seconds.

rec_s_giga_belt.name: Sacrifice Belt
rec_s_giga_belt.description: A huge amount of max HP. Drawback: loses 1.5% max HP every second.

rec_r_giga_belt.name: Pride Belt
rec_r_giga_belt.description: An enormous amount of max HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second.

rec_s_trap_claw.name: Banshee Claw
rec_s_trap_claw.description: The holder and allies next to it in the same row each block the first magic hit from an enemy. Drawback: no stun.

rec_r_trap_claw.name: Banshee Silence
rec_r_trap_claw.description: Every ally blocks the first magic hit from an enemy, and the holder stuns that attacker for 3 seconds.

rec_s_thief_gloves.name: Trickster Gloves
rec_s_thief_gloves.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items, plus 25% attack damage and 25 ability power. Drawback: 10% less max HP.

rec_r_thief_gloves.name: Rascal Gloves
rec_r_thief_gloves.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items.

rec_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
rec_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

rec_tome.name: Tome of Traits
rec_tome.description: Drag onto any Digimon to open a pick of 4 Crests, including Crests no recipe makes.

consumable:rec_tome.name: Tome of Traits
consumable:rec_tome.description: Open a pick of 4 Crests, including Crests no recipe makes.

DSP.name: Dark Spore
DSP.description: Dark Spore Digimon gain attack damage and ability power. Each Shadow item held by a Dark Spore Digimon makes the bonus 20% bigger, up to 4 items.

TRK.name: Tricksters
TRK.description: Tricksters gain attack speed. When a Trickster is knocked out, a copy one form lower jumps in with 55% HP. Copies do not copy again.

SER.name: Seraphic
SER.description: Seraphic Digimon gain armor, magic resist and ability power. When one is knocked out, its bonus is split among the Seraphic Digimon still standing.

NGT.name: Nightfall
NGT.description: The first time a Nightfall Digimon drops below 50% HP, it gains a shield for 8 seconds and deals more damage for the rest of combat.

DAY.name: Daybreak
DAY.description: The first time a Daybreak Digimon drops below 50% HP, it quickly heals part of its max HP. Each time this happens, every Daybreak Digimon deals 8% more damage.

CHI.name: Chimera
CHI.description: When 3 of your Digimon have been knocked out, Kimeramon rises where the third fell. It copies one random item from up to 3 Chimera Digimon and grows with their forms.

WIT.name: Witchelny
WIT.description: At the start of combat, the Digimon closest to the center of your Witchelny Digimon becomes the Coven Leader and gains ability power. Each time a Witchelny Digimon casts, the Leader gains 30% of that ability's mana cost.

DRK.name: Dragon Kin
DRK.description: Dragon Kin Digimon gain max HP. After each player combat you get a Digi-Egg that hatches into loot after 1 to 3 rounds; bigger eggs take longer and hold better loot. With 5, the eggs are golden and hold more.

HNT.name: Dragon Hunter
HNT.description: Dragon Hunters gain ability power. The first time a Dragon Hunter knocks out an enemy with 1500 or more max HP, your whole team gains ability power for the rest of combat.

PHA.name: Phantom
PHA.description: The first time a Phantom Digimon would be knocked out, it rises again with part of its max HP. After rising, it deals 20% and takes 30% more damage.

SEN.name: Sentinel
SEN.description: At the start of combat, the Sentinel holding the most items gains a shield that grants attack speed. When the shield breaks or runs out (at most once per duration), it jumps to the ally with the lowest HP and renews, and its attack speed grows each jump (up to 5 times).

RIV.name: Royal Rival
RIV.description: Gallantmon and Megidramon are rivals. A Royal Rival deals 20% more damage to enemies with one of its rival traits, but only while you field exactly one of them. Gallantmon's rivals: Dark Spore, Nightfall, Witchelny, Tricksters, Dragon Hunter, Chimera, Phantom. Megidramon's rivals: Seraphic, Daybreak, Dragon Kin, Chrome Digizoid, Sentinel.

ETR.name: Twin Souls
ETR.description: Sakuyamon fights with a partner: at the start of combat, Garurumon appears next to it at the same form. Garurumon does not use a team slot.

INA.name: Hallowed Mist
INA.description: At the start of combat, this Digimon and the allies next to it take 33% less damage for 8 seconds.

ASN.name: Assassin
ASN.description: Assassins leap to the enemy backline when combat starts. Their abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and damage.

CAV.name: Cavalier
CAV.description: Cavaliers take less damage. For the first 4 seconds of combat and for 3 seconds after each ability, the reduction is doubled.

INV.name: Invoker
INV.description: All your Digimon gain extra mana from their basic attacks.

KNT.name: Knight
KNT.description: All your Digimon block a flat amount of damage from every hit (burns are not blocked).

LEG.name: Legionnaire
LEG.description: Legionnaires gain attack speed. Their first basic attack after an ability heals them for 50% of its damage.

MYS.name: Mystic
MYS.description: All your Digimon gain magic resist.

RNG.name: Ranger
RNG.description: Starting 4 seconds into combat, Rangers gain a burst of attack speed for 4 seconds, every 8 seconds.

REN.name: Renewer
REN.description: Renewers heal a share of their max HP every second. At full HP they gain that share of their mana instead.

SKR.name: Skirmisher
SKR.description: Skirmishers start combat with a shield and gain attack damage every second.

SPW.name: Spellweaver
SPW.description: Spellweavers gain ability power, and more each time any Digimon casts an ability, up to 10 times.

CAN.name: Cannoneer
CAN.description: Every 5th basic attack of a Cannoneer also fires a cannon shot that deals a share of that attack's damage to the target and enemies next to it.

trait:KNT:0.description: Every Digimon on your team takes 15 less damage from each hit

trait:KNT:1.description: Every Digimon on your team takes 30 less damage from each hit

trait:KNT:2.description: Every Digimon on your team takes 50 less damage from each hit

trait:LEG:0.description: 20% attack speed; the first attack after an ability heals for 50% of its damage

trait:LEG:1.description: 45% attack speed; the first attack after an ability heals for 50% of its damage

trait:LEG:2.description: 80% attack speed; the first attack after an ability heals for 50% of its damage

trait:REN:0.description: Heal 2.5% max HP per second, or gain 2.5% max mana per second at full HP

trait:REN:1.description: Heal 5% max HP per second, or gain 5% max mana per second at full HP

trait:SKR:0.description: A 25% max HP shield at the start, +3 AD every second (more at higher forms)

trait:SKR:1.description: A 45% max HP shield at the start, +6 AD every second (more at higher forms)

trait:SPW:0.description: +30 AP, +4 AP each time any Digimon casts (up to 10 times)

trait:SPW:1.description: +65 AP, +7 AP each time any Digimon casts (up to 10 times)

trait:CAN:0.description: Every 5th attack: 200% of the attack's damage to the target and enemies next to it

trait:CAN:1.description: Every 5th attack: 450% of the attack's damage to the target and enemies next to it

ability:rec_keramon:0.description: Fires through the target, dealing 190 magic damage to every enemy in a line.

ability:rec_wormmon:0.description: Strikes the target for 210 magic damage, doubled if it is below 50% HP.
ability:rec_wormmon:0.scaledDescription: Strikes the target for {value} magic damage, doubled if it is below 50% HP.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

rec_a_training.name: Training Disk
rec_a_training.description: Your team gains 10% attack damage and 10 ability power.

rec_a_mist.name: Black Mist
rec_a_mist.description: When one of your Digimon is knocked out, enemies within 2 hexes of it take 150 magic damage.

rec_a_front.name: Iron Front
rec_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 25 armor, 25 magic resist and 150 HP.

rec_a_nest.name: Sniper Nest
rec_a_nest.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 20% attack speed.

rec_a_trove.name: Shadow Trove
rec_a_trove.description: Gain a random Shadow item and a component.

rec_a_xanti.name: X-Antibody
rec_a_xanti.description: The drawbacks of your Shadow items are halved, and your Digimon holding a Shadow item gain 150 HP.

rec_a_vamp.name: Celestial Blessing
rec_a_vamp.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

rec_a_mana.name: Overcharge
rec_a_mana.description: Your team starts combat with 25 extra mana.

rec_a_unity.name: Stand United
rec_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each active trait.

rec_a_ascend.name: Ascension
rec_a_ascend.description: After 12 seconds of combat, your team deals 35% more damage.

rec_a_blessing.name: Early Blessing
rec_a_blessing.description: Receive your Radiant Blessing at the start of the next free round instead of waiting until you drop low.

rec_a_nature.name: Force of Nature
rec_a_nature.description: Gain a Force of Nature (+1 team size).

rec_a_darkness.name: Force of Darkness
rec_a_darkness.description: Gain +2 team size. Drawback: every loss costs you twice the usual Tamer HP.

rec_a_tome.name: Tome Collection
rec_a_tome.description: Gain 2 Tomes of Traits and a Digi-Egg.

offer:rec_bless.name: Radiant Blessing
offer:rec_bless.description: You dropped low. Pick one Radiant upgrade: it upgrades an item you hold, or goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_victory_sword.name: Victory Sword
choice:rec_bless:rec_victory_sword.description: +40% AD. Deals 8% more damage. Each knockout gives +12% attack damage for the rest of combat. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_titan_slayer.name: Titan Slayer
choice:rec_bless:rec_titan_slayer.description: +15% AD, +12% AS. Deals 8% more damage, and 35% more to enemies with 1600 or more max HP. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_gunblade.name: Data Gunblade
choice:rec_bless:rec_gunblade.description: +15% AD, +15 AP. Heals for 22% of all damage dealt. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_lance.name: Mana Lance
choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_lance.description: +15% AD, +15 mana. Basic attacks restore 6 extra mana. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_guardian_feather.name: Guardian Feather
choice:rec_bless:rec_guardian_feather.description: +15% AD, +20 armor. The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with 30% max HP. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_blood_fang.name: Blood Fang
choice:rec_bless:rec_blood_fang.description: +15% AD, +20 MR. Heals for 25% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 25% max HP shield once. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_war_banner.name: War Banner
choice:rec_bless:rec_war_banner.description: +15% AD, +150 HP. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 25% attack speed. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_crit_edge.name: Crit Edge
choice:rec_bless:rec_crit_edge.description: +15% AD, +55% crit, +8% dodge. Grants extra critical strike chance and 10% crit damage. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_rapid_cannon.name: Rapid Cannon
choice:rec_bless:rec_rapid_cannon.description: +49% AS. +1 attack range and extra attack speed. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_rage_wing.name: Rage Wing
choice:rec_bless:rec_rage_wing.description: +12% AS, +15 AP. Each basic attack grants 6% attack speed, stacking. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_volt_disk.name: Volt Disk
choice:rec_bless:rec_volt_disk.description: +12% AS, +15 mana. Every 3rd basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_titan_will.name: Titan Will
choice:rec_bless:rec_titan_will.description: +12% AS, +20 armor. Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_twin_shot.name: Twin Shot
choice:rec_bless:rec_twin_shot.description: +12% AS, +20 MR. Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 55% damage. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_void_portal.name: Void Portal
choice:rec_bless:rec_void_portal.description: +12% AS, +150 HP. At the start of combat, enemies within 2 hexes target the holder. When the holder is knocked out, a Voidlarva rises in its place. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_armor_breaker.name: Armor Breaker
choice:rec_bless:rec_armor_breaker.description: +12% AS, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 40% for 3 seconds. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_ultima_wand.name: Ultima Wand
choice:rec_bless:rec_ultima_wand.description: +70 AP. A lot of ability power. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_seraph_staff.name: Seraph Staff
choice:rec_bless:rec_seraph_staff.description: +15 AP, +15 mana. Each cast grants ability power equal to 30% of the holder's max mana. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_iron_locket.name: Iron Locket
choice:rec_bless:rec_iron_locket.description: +15 AP, +20 armor. At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain a 250 shield (350 Champion form, 450 final form). Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_zap.name: Mana Zap
choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_zap.description: +15 AP, +20 MR. When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 180 magic damage. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_flame_tome.name: Flame Tome
choice:rec_bless:rec_flame_tome.description: +15 AP, +150 HP. Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_jewel_gauntlet.name: Jewel Gauntlet
choice:rec_bless:rec_jewel_gauntlet.description: +15 AP, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Abilities can critically strike. +30% crit damage. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_overflow.name: Mana Overflow
choice:rec_bless:rec_mana_overflow.description: +30 mana. Max mana -10. After casting, keeps 20 mana. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_frost_heart.name: Frost Heart
choice:rec_bless:rec_frost_heart.description: +15 mana, +20 armor. Enemies within 2 hexes have 25% less attack speed. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_power_chalice.name: Power Chalice
choice:rec_bless:rec_power_chalice.description: +15 mana, +20 MR. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 25 ability power. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_holy_ring.name: Holy Ring
choice:rec_bless:rec_holy_ring.description: +15 mana, +150 HP. Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_justice_hand.name: Justice Hand
choice:rec_bless:rec_justice_hand.description: +15 mana, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_spike_plate.name: Spike Plate
choice:rec_bless:rec_spike_plate.description: +60 armor. When attacked, deals 60 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown). Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_stone_hide.name: Stone Hide
choice:rec_bless:rec_stone_hide.description: +20 armor, +20 MR. Gains 12 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_flame_core.name: Flame Core
choice:rec_bless:rec_flame_core.description: +20 armor, +150 HP. Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_still_shroud.name: Still Shroud
choice:rec_bless:rec_still_shroud.description: +20 armor, +10% crit, +8% dodge. At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column need 35% more mana for their first cast. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
choice:rec_bless:rec_dragon_scale.description: +110 MR. A lot of magic resist. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_wind_ward.name: Wind Ward
choice:rec_bless:rec_wind_ward.description: +20 MR, +150 HP. At the start of combat, the enemy facing the holder across the board is stunned for 4 seconds, even if immune. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_quick_silver.name: Quick Silver
choice:rec_bless:rec_quick_silver.description: +20 MR, +10% crit, +8% dodge, +10% AS. Immune to stuns for the first 12 seconds. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_giga_belt.name: Giga Belt
choice:rec_bless:rec_giga_belt.description: +750 HP. A lot of max HP. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_trap_claw.name: Trap Claw
choice:rec_bless:rec_trap_claw.description: +150 HP, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Blocks the first magic hit from an enemy and stuns the attacker for 3 seconds. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_thief_gloves.name: Thief Gloves
choice:rec_bless:rec_thief_gloves.description: +20% crit, +16% dodge. Each combat, gains two random completed items. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_skr.name: Skirmisher Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_skr.description: +15% AD. The holder gains the Skirmisher trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_leg.name: Legionnaire Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_leg.description: +12% AS. The holder gains the Legionnaire trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_spw.name: Spellweaver Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_spw.description: +15 AP. The holder gains the Spellweaver trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_ren.name: Renewer Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_ren.description: +15 mana. The holder gains the Renewer trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_irn.name: Chrome Digizoid Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_irn.description: +20 armor. The holder gains the Chrome Digizoid trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_ser.name: Seraphic Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_ser.description: +20 MR. The holder gains the Seraphic trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_day.name: Daybreak Crest
choice:rec_bless:emblem_day.description: +150 HP. The holder gains the Daybreak trait. Upgrades your item if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:emblem_asn.name: Assassin Crest

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_victory_sword.name: Ruin Sword
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_victory_sword.description: +45% AD. Deals 15% more damage. Each knockout gives +20% attack damage. Drawback: 15% less max HP. Upgrades your Victory Sword if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_victory_sword.name: Luminous Sword
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_victory_sword.description: +65% AD. Deals 20% more damage. Each knockout gives +20% attack damage. Upgrades your Victory Sword if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_titan_slayer.name: Spectral Slayer
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_titan_slayer.description: +15% AD, +12% AS. Deals 50% more damage to enemies with 1100 or more max HP. Drawback: no bonus against smaller enemies. Upgrades your Titan Slayer if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_titan_slayer.name: Demon Slayer
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_titan_slayer.description: +15% AD, +22% AS. Deals 30% more damage, and 40% more on top to enemies with 1600 or more max HP. Upgrades your Titan Slayer if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_gunblade.name: Mercy Gunblade
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_gunblade.description: +15% AD, +15 AP. Magic damage the holder deals heals the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of it. Drawback: the holder heals nothing from it. Upgrades your Data Gunblade if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_gunblade.name: Lifeblade
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_gunblade.description: +15% AD, +45 AP. Heals for 40% of all damage dealt. Upgrades your Data Gunblade if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_lance.name: Spectral Lance
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_lance.description: +15% AD, +15 mana. Basic attacks restore 14 extra mana. Drawback: deals 10% less damage. Upgrades your Mana Lance if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_lance.name: Lance of Light
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_lance.description: +15% AD, +15 mana, +25 AP. Basic attacks restore 12 extra mana. Upgrades your Mana Lance if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_guardian_feather.name: Fallen Feather
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_guardian_feather.description: +15% AD, +20 armor. The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with 70% max HP. Drawback: after that it has 50% less attack speed. Upgrades your Guardian Feather if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_guardian_feather.name: Archangel Feather
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_guardian_feather.description: +15% AD, +20 armor, +30% AS. The first time the holder would be knocked out, it is held safe for 2 seconds, then returns with full HP. Upgrades your Guardian Feather if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_blood_fang.name: Risk Fang
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_blood_fang.description: +15% AD, +20 MR. Heals for 40% of damage dealt. Each time it heals back above 90% HP, it gains 40% attack speed for 4 seconds. Drawback: starts combat at 80% HP. Upgrades your Blood Fang if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_blood_fang.name: Blessed Fang
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_blood_fang.description: +35% AD, +20 MR. Heals for 50% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 40% max HP shield once. Upgrades your Blood Fang if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_war_banner.name: Bleak Banner
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_war_banner.description: +15% AD, +150 HP. At the start of combat, allies next to the holder in the same row lose 20% attack speed, and the holder gains 35% attack speed for each of them. Drawback: slows those allies. Upgrades your War Banner if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_war_banner.name: Harmony Banner
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_war_banner.description: +15% AD, +150 HP. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 45% attack speed and 10% omnivamp. Upgrades your War Banner if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_crit_edge.name: Sacrifice Edge
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_crit_edge.description: +15% AD, +60% crit, +8% dodge. Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 2% of its max HP. Upgrades your Crit Edge if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_crit_edge.name: Zenith Edge
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_crit_edge.description: +15% AD, +70% crit, +8% dodge. Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Abilities can critically strike. Upgrades your Crit Edge if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_rapid_cannon.name: Rapid Deathcannon
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_rapid_cannon.description: +24% AS. +1 attack range. Gains 75% attack speed while no enemy is within 2 hexes. Drawback: no flat attack speed bonus. Upgrades your Rapid Cannon if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_rapid_cannon.name: Light Cannon
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_rapid_cannon.description: +104% AS, +15% AD. +2 attack range and a lot of attack speed. Upgrades your Rapid Cannon if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_rage_wing.name: Blood Rage Wing
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_rage_wing.description: +12% AS, +15 AP. Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 1.5% of its max HP. Upgrades your Rage Wing if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_rage_wing.name: Reckoning Wing
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_rage_wing.description: +42% AS, +15 AP. Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking. Upgrades your Rage Wing if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_volt_disk.name: Volt Stiletto
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_volt_disk.description: +12% AS, +15 mana. Every 2nd basic attack sends lightning to 4 enemies for 80 magic damage. Drawback: 30% less attack damage. Upgrades your Volt Disk if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_volt_disk.name: Volt Favor
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_volt_disk.description: +32% AS, +15 mana. Every 3rd basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 160 magic damage. Upgrades your Volt Disk if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_titan_will.name: Titan Revenge
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_titan_will.description: +12% AS, +35 armor. Stores 60% of the damage the holder takes. Every 2 seconds its next basic attack releases the store as true damage. Drawback: no stacking stats. Upgrades your Titan Will if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_titan_will.name: Titan Vow
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_titan_will.description: +12% AS, +50 armor, +30 MR, +20% AD. Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times. Upgrades your Titan Will if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_twin_shot.name: Wild Twin Shot
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_twin_shot.description: +12% AS, +20 MR. Basic attacks also hit 2 more nearby enemies for 70% damage. Drawback: 10% less attack damage. Upgrades your Twin Shot if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_twin_shot.name: Twin Tempest
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_twin_shot.description: +42% AS, +20 MR. Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for full damage. Upgrades your Twin Shot if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_void_portal.name: Unstable Portal
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_void_portal.description: +12% AS, +150 HP. Like Void Portal, but the Voidlarva deals 250 true damage to enemies next to it when it falls. Drawback: 10% less max HP. Upgrades your Void Portal if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_void_portal.name: Void Invitation
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_void_portal.description: +12% AS, +350 HP. At the start of combat, a Voidlarva rises next to the holder and enemies within 3 hexes target it. When the holder is knocked out, another rises. Upgrades your Void Portal if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_armor_breaker.name: Final Whisper
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_armor_breaker.description: +12% AS, +25% crit, +8% dodge. Critical strikes cut the target's armor and magic resist by 70% for 5 seconds. Drawback: the holder has 20% less armor and magic resist. Upgrades your Armor Breaker if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_armor_breaker.name: Eternal Whisper
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_armor_breaker.description: +12% AS, +45% crit, +8% dodge. Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 70% for 3 seconds. Upgrades your Armor Breaker if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_ultima_wand.name: Caustic Wand
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_ultima_wand.description: +120 AP. A huge amount of ability power. Drawback: 15% less max HP. Upgrades your Ultima Wand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_ultima_wand.name: Ascended Wand
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_ultima_wand.description: +155 AP. An enormous amount of ability power. Upgrades your Ultima Wand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_seraph_staff.name: Undying Staff
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_seraph_staff.description: +15 AP, +15 mana. Each cast grants max HP equal to 3.5 times the holder's max mana and heals that much. Drawback: no ability power gain. Upgrades your Seraph Staff if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_seraph_staff.name: Holy Staff
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_seraph_staff.description: +45 AP, +30 mana. Each cast grants ability power equal to 60% of the holder's max mana. Upgrades your Seraph Staff if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_iron_locket.name: Lunar Locket
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_iron_locket.description: +15 AP, +20 armor. At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 60 armor and magic resist. Drawback: they gain 5 less mana per basic attack. Upgrades your Iron Locket if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_iron_locket.name: Prime Locket
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_iron_locket.description: +15 AP, +20 armor. At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 3 hexes in the same row gain a 450 shield (600 Champion form, 750 final form) and 200 max HP. Upgrades your Iron Locket if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_zap.name: Dark Spark
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_zap.description: +15 AP, +20 MR. When any other Digimon within 2 hexes casts, it is zapped: enemies take twice their max mana as magic damage, allies half their max mana. The holder gains 10 AP per zap. Drawback: zaps allies too. Upgrades your Mana Zap if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_zap.name: Covalent Spark
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_zap.description: +15 AP, +60 MR. When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 400 magic damage. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. Upgrades your Mana Zap if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_flame_tome.name: Evil Tome
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_flame_tome.description: +35 AP, +150 HP. Magic damage curses the target: 6% of its max HP as true damage per second for 8 seconds, and less healing. Drawback: the holder's other magic damage is 20% lower. Upgrades your Flame Tome if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_flame_tome.name: Radiant Tome
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_flame_tome.description: +45 AP, +150 HP. Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing. Deals 20% more damage. Upgrades your Flame Tome if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.name: Sacrifice Gauntlet
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.description: +15 AP, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Abilities can critically strike. +50% crit damage, and +25% crit chance after the first cast. Drawback: each cast costs HP equal to half the max mana times the form (1, 2, 3). Upgrades your Jewel Gauntlet if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.name: Glamor Gauntlet
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.description: +35 AP, +35% crit, +8% dodge. Abilities can critically strike. +90% crit damage. Upgrades your Jewel Gauntlet if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_overflow.name: Dark Overflow
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_mana_overflow.description: +30 mana. After casting, keeps 50 mana while below 60% HP. Drawback: only 20 mana above 60% HP, and max mana is not lowered. Upgrades your Mana Overflow if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_overflow.name: Blue Blessing
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_mana_overflow.description: +30 mana, +20 AP. Max mana -10. After casting, keeps 30 mana. Upgrades your Mana Overflow if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_frost_heart.name: Frozen Dark Heart
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_frost_heart.description: +15 mana, +20 armor. Enemies within 2 hexes have 35% less attack speed. Drawback: allies next to the holder have 25% less attack speed too. Upgrades your Frost Heart if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_frost_heart.name: Frost Heart of Gold
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_frost_heart.description: +45 mana, +60 armor. Enemies within 2 hexes have 50% less attack speed. Upgrades your Frost Heart if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_power_chalice.name: Malice Chalice
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_power_chalice.description: +15 mana, +20 MR. At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 45 ability power. Drawback: the holder loses 20 ability power. Upgrades your Power Chalice if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_power_chalice.name: Charity Chalice
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_power_chalice.description: +15 mana, +20 MR. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 50 ability power and 10% omnivamp. Upgrades your Power Chalice if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_holy_ring.name: Sacrifice Ring
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_holy_ring.description: +15 mana, +150 HP. Every 5 seconds, heals every other ally for 25% of its missing HP. Drawback: each time, the holder loses 5% of its current HP. Upgrades your Holy Ring if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_holy_ring.name: Radiant Ring
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_holy_ring.description: +15 mana, +500 HP. Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. Upgrades your Holy Ring if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_justice_hand.name: Vengeance Hand
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_justice_hand.description: +15 mana, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Gains 30% attack damage, 30 ability power and 20% omnivamp. Drawback: these switch off after each knockout the holder scores and come back on the next one. Upgrades your Justice Hand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_justice_hand.name: Fairness Fist
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_justice_hand.description: +15 mana, +10% crit, +8% dodge, +15% AD, +15 AP. Deals 20% more damage and heals for 20% of damage dealt. Upgrades your Justice Hand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_spike_plate.name: Refracted Plate
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_spike_plate.description: +160 armor. A huge amount of armor. Drawback: no spikes. Upgrades your Spike Plate if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_spike_plate.name: Rosethorn Plate
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_spike_plate.description: +60 armor. When attacked, deals 200 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown). Regenerates 2% max HP per second. Upgrades your Spike Plate if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_stone_hide.name: Undying Stone
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_stone_hide.description: +20 armor, +20 MR. Every 2 seconds, heals 2% max HP for each enemy within 2 hexes. Drawback: no armor or magic resist from nearby enemies. Upgrades your Stone Hide if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_stone_hide.name: Dvarapala Stone
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_stone_hide.description: +20 armor, +20 MR. Gains 20 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes. Regenerates 2% max HP per second. Upgrades your Stone Hide if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_flame_core.name: Eclipse Core
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_flame_core.description: +20 armor, +300 HP. Every 1.5 seconds, burns a random enemy within 3 hexes. Drawback: the holder burns itself for the first 5 seconds. Upgrades your Flame Core if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_flame_core.name: Sunlight Core
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_flame_core.description: +20 armor, +150 HP. Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes, and every 1.5 seconds a random enemy within 4 hexes. Regenerates 0.5% max HP per second. Upgrades your Flame Core if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_s_still_shroud.name: Dark Shroud
choice:rec_bless:rec_s_still_shroud.description: +20 armor, +10% crit, +8% dodge. At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column need 80% more mana for their first cast. Drawback: allies in that column need 40% more. Upgrades your Still Shroud if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_bless:rec_r_still_shroud.name: Reverent Shroud
choice:rec_bless:rec_r_still_shroud.description: +20 armor, +10% crit, +8% dodge. At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns next to it need 50% more mana for their first cast. Allies start with 15 more mana. choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_blood_fang.description: +35% AD, +20 MR. Heals for 50% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gains a 40% max HP shield once. Upgrades your Blood Fang if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_war_banner.name: Bleak Banner
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_war_banner.description: +15% AD, +150 HP. At the start of combat, allies next to the holder in the same row lose 20% attack speed, and the holder gains 35% attack speed for each of them. Drawback: slows those allies. Upgrades your War Banner if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_war_banner.name: Harmony Banner
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_war_banner.description: +15% AD, +150 HP. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 45% attack speed and 10% omnivamp. Upgrades your War Banner if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_crit_edge.name: Sacrifice Edge
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_crit_edge.description: +15% AD, +60% crit, +8% dodge. Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 2% of its max HP. Upgrades your Crit Edge if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_crit_edge.name: Zenith Edge
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_crit_edge.description: +15% AD, +70% crit, +8% dodge. Grants extra critical strike chance and 50% crit damage. Abilities can critically strike. Upgrades your Crit Edge if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_rapid_cannon.name: Rapid Deathcannon
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_rapid_cannon.description: +24% AS. +1 attack range. Gains 75% attack speed while no enemy is within 2 hexes. Drawback: no flat attack speed bonus. Upgrades your Rapid Cannon if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_rapid_cannon.name: Light Cannon
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_rapid_cannon.description: +104% AS, +15% AD. +2 attack range and a lot of attack speed. Upgrades your Rapid Cannon if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_rage_wing.name: Blood Rage Wing
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_rage_wing.description: +12% AS, +15 AP. Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking. Drawback: each basic attack costs the holder 1.5% of its max HP. Upgrades your Rage Wing if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_rage_wing.name: Reckoning Wing
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_rage_wing.description: +42% AS, +15 AP. Each basic attack grants 10% attack speed, stacking. Upgrades your Rage Wing if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_volt_disk.name: Volt Stiletto
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_volt_disk.description: +12% AS, +15 mana. Every 2nd basic attack sends lightning to 4 enemies for 80 magic damage. Drawback: 30% less attack damage. Upgrades your Volt Disk if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_volt_disk.name: Volt Favor
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_volt_disk.description: +32% AS, +15 mana. Every 3rd basic attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 160 magic damage. Upgrades your Volt Disk if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_titan_will.name: Titan Revenge
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_titan_will.description: +12% AS, +35 armor. Stores 60% of the damage the holder takes. Every 2 seconds its next basic attack releases the store as true damage. Drawback: no stacking stats. Upgrades your Titan Will if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_titan_will.name: Titan Vow
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_titan_will.description: +12% AS, +50 armor, +30 MR, +20% AD. Attacking or being attacked grants 2% attack damage and 2 ability power, up to 25 times. Upgrades your Titan Will if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_twin_shot.name: Wild Twin Shot
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_twin_shot.description: +12% AS, +20 MR. Basic attacks also hit 2 more nearby enemies for 70% damage. Drawback: 10% less attack damage. Upgrades your Twin Shot if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_twin_shot.name: Twin Tempest
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_twin_shot.description: +42% AS, +20 MR. Basic attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for full damage. Upgrades your Twin Shot if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_void_portal.name: Unstable Portal
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_void_portal.description: +12% AS, +150 HP. Like Void Portal, but the Voidlarva deals 250 true damage to enemies next to it when it falls. Drawback: 10% less max HP. Upgrades your Void Portal if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_void_portal.name: Void Invitation
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_void_portal.description: +12% AS, +350 HP. At the start of combat, a Voidlarva rises next to the holder and enemies within 3 hexes target it. When the holder is knocked out, another rises. Upgrades your Void Portal if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_armor_breaker.name: Final Whisper
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_armor_breaker.description: +12% AS, +25% crit, +8% dodge. Critical strikes cut the target's armor and magic resist by 70% for 5 seconds. Drawback: the holder has 20% less armor and magic resist. Upgrades your Armor Breaker if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_armor_breaker.name: Eternal Whisper
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_armor_breaker.description: +12% AS, +45% crit, +8% dodge. Basic attacks cut the target's armor by 70% for 3 seconds. Upgrades your Armor Breaker if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_ultima_wand.name: Caustic Wand
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_ultima_wand.description: +120 AP. A huge amount of ability power. Drawback: 15% less max HP. Upgrades your Ultima Wand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_ultima_wand.name: Ascended Wand
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_ultima_wand.description: +155 AP. An enormous amount of ability power. Upgrades your Ultima Wand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_seraph_staff.name: Undying Staff
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_seraph_staff.description: +15 AP, +15 mana. Each cast grants max HP equal to 3.5 times the holder's max mana and heals that much. Drawback: no ability power gain. Upgrades your Seraph Staff if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_seraph_staff.name: Holy Staff
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_seraph_staff.description: +45 AP, +30 mana. Each cast grants ability power equal to 60% of the holder's max mana. Upgrades your Seraph Staff if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_iron_locket.name: Lunar Locket
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_iron_locket.description: +15 AP, +20 armor. At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 60 armor and magic resist. Drawback: they gain 5 less mana per basic attack. Upgrades your Iron Locket if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_iron_locket.name: Prime Locket
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_iron_locket.description: +15 AP, +20 armor. At the start of combat, the holder and allies within 3 hexes in the same row gain a 450 shield (600 Champion form, 750 final form) and 200 max HP. Upgrades your Iron Locket if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_mana_zap.name: Dark Spark
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_mana_zap.description: +15 AP, +20 MR. When any other Digimon within 2 hexes casts, it is zapped: enemies take twice their max mana as magic damage, allies half their max mana. The holder gains 10 AP per zap. Drawback: zaps allies too. Upgrades your Mana Zap if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_mana_zap.name: Covalent Spark
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_mana_zap.description: +15 AP, +60 MR. When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, it takes 400 magic damage. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. Upgrades your Mana Zap if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_flame_tome.name: Evil Tome
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_flame_tome.description: +35 AP, +150 HP. Magic damage curses the target: 6% of its max HP as true damage per second for 8 seconds, and less healing. Drawback: the holder's other magic damage is 20% lower. Upgrades your Flame Tome if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_flame_tome.name: Radiant Tome
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_flame_tome.description: +45 AP, +150 HP. Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing. Deals 20% more damage. Upgrades your Flame Tome if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.name: Sacrifice Gauntlet
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_jewel_gauntlet.description: +15 AP, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Abilities can critically strike. +50% crit damage, and +25% crit chance after the first cast. Drawback: each cast costs HP equal to half the max mana times the form (1, 2, 3). Upgrades your Jewel Gauntlet if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.name: Glamor Gauntlet
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_jewel_gauntlet.description: +35 AP, +35% crit, +8% dodge. Abilities can critically strike. +90% crit damage. Upgrades your Jewel Gauntlet if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_mana_overflow.name: Dark Overflow
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_mana_overflow.description: +30 mana. After casting, keeps 50 mana while below 60% HP. Drawback: only 20 mana above 60% HP, and max mana is not lowered. Upgrades your Mana Overflow if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_mana_overflow.name: Blue Blessing
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_mana_overflow.description: +30 mana, +20 AP. Max mana -10. After casting, keeps 30 mana. Upgrades your Mana Overflow if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_frost_heart.name: Frozen Dark Heart
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_frost_heart.description: +15 mana, +20 armor. Enemies within 2 hexes have 35% less attack speed. Drawback: allies next to the holder have 25% less attack speed too. Upgrades your Frost Heart if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_frost_heart.name: Frost Heart of Gold
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_frost_heart.description: +45 mana, +60 armor. Enemies within 2 hexes have 50% less attack speed. Upgrades your Frost Heart if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_power_chalice.name: Malice Chalice
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_power_chalice.description: +15 mana, +20 MR. At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes in the same row gain 45 ability power. Drawback: the holder loses 20 ability power. Upgrades your Power Chalice if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_power_chalice.name: Charity Chalice
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_power_chalice.description: +15 mana, +20 MR. At the start of combat, the holder and allies next to it in the same row gain 50 ability power and 10% omnivamp. Upgrades your Power Chalice if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_holy_ring.name: Sacrifice Ring
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_holy_ring.description: +15 mana, +150 HP. Every 5 seconds, heals every other ally for 25% of its missing HP. Drawback: each time, the holder loses 5% of its current HP. Upgrades your Holy Ring if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_holy_ring.name: Radiant Ring
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_holy_ring.description: +15 mana, +500 HP. Every 5 seconds, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 plus 10% of their missing HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. Upgrades your Holy Ring if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_justice_hand.name: Vengeance Hand
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_justice_hand.description: +15 mana, +10% crit, +8% dodge. Gains 30% attack damage, 30 ability power and 20% omnivamp. Drawback: these switch off after each knockout the holder scores and come back on the next one. Upgrades your Justice Hand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_justice_hand.name: Fairness Fist
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_justice_hand.description: +15 mana, +10% crit, +8% dodge, +15% AD, +15 AP. Deals 20% more damage and heals for 20% of damage dealt. Upgrades your Justice Hand if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_spike_plate.name: Refracted Plate
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_spike_plate.description: +160 armor. A huge amount of armor. Drawback: no spikes. Upgrades your Spike Plate if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_spike_plate.name: Rosethorn Plate
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_spike_plate.description: +60 armor. When attacked, deals 200 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5 second cooldown). Regenerates 2% max HP per second. Upgrades your Spike Plate if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_stone_hide.name: Undying Stone
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_stone_hide.description: +20 armor, +20 MR. Every 2 seconds, heals 2% max HP for each enemy within 2 hexes. Drawback: no armor or magic resist from nearby enemies. Upgrades your Stone Hide if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_stone_hide.name: Dvarapala Stone
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_stone_hide.description: +20 armor, +20 MR. Gains 20 armor and magic resist for each enemy within 2 hexes. Regenerates 2% max HP per second. Upgrades your Stone Hide if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_flame_core.name: Eclipse Core
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_flame_core.description: +20 armor, +300 HP. Every 1.5 seconds, burns a random enemy within 3 hexes. Drawback: the holder burns itself for the first 5 seconds. Upgrades your Flame Core if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_flame_core.name: Sunlight Core
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_flame_core.description: +20 armor, +150 HP. Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes, and every 1.5 seconds a random enemy within 4 hexes. Regenerates 0.5% max HP per second. Upgrades your Flame Core if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_still_shroud.name: Dark Shroud
choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_still_shroud.description: +20 armor, +10% crit, +8% dodge. At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column need 80% more mana for their first cast. Drawback: allies in that column need 40% more. Upgrades your Still Shroud if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_still_shroud.name: Reverent Shroud
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_still_shroud.description: +20 armor, +10% crit, +8% dodge. At the start of combat, enemies in the holder's column and the columns next to it need 50% more mana for their first cast. Allies start with 15 more mana. Upgrades your Still Shroud if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_dragon_scale.name: Refracted Scale

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_dragon_scale.name: Dragon Will
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_dragon_scale.description: +240 MR. A huge amount of magic resist. Regenerates 2% max HP per second. Upgrades your Dragon Scale if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_s_wind_ward.description: +20 MR, +300 HP. At the start of combat, the enemy facing the holder across the board is stunned for 7 seconds, even if immune. choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_wind_ward.name: Mistral Ward
choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_wind_ward.description: +20 MR, +150 HP. At the start of combat, the enemy facing the holder across the board is stunned for 6 seconds, even if immune, and your team gains 10% attack speed. Upgrades your Wind Ward if you hold one, otherwise goes to your item bench.

choice:rec_radiant:rec_r_quick_silver.name: Quickest Silver
