duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

arc_a_training.name: Combat Training
arc_a_training.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

arc_a_wind.name: Second Wind
arc_a_wind.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of missing HP.

arc_a_feather.name: Featherweights
arc_a_feather.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_front.name: Frontline Fortitude
arc_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 MR and 200 HP.

arc_a_back.name: Backline Barrage
arc_a_back.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_shimmer.name: Syndicate Ties
arc_a_shimmer.description: Gain 60 Shimmer and a Mushroomon. Your Syndicate Digimon gain 150 HP.

arc_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
arc_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

arc_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
arc_a_evolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

arc_a_blessing.name: Celestial Blessing
arc_a_blessing.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
arc_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

arc_a_overcharge.name: Overcharged
arc_a_overcharge.description: Your team starts combat with 25 extra mana.

arc_a_find.name: Golden Find
arc_a_find.description: Gain 6 free rerolls now. Your Anomaly Digimon drops 1 gold for every 3 knockouts it scores.

arc_a_unity.name: Stand United
arc_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP per active trait.

arc_a_crown.name: Crowned
arc_a_crown.description: Gain a Tamer's Crown (+1 team size).

arc_a_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
arc_a_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 4.

arc_a_mutant.name: Double Mutation
arc_a_mutant.description: You get a second Anomaly pick, for a different Digimon, the round after your first. Gain 6 gold.

arc_a_market.name: Black Market Pass
arc_a_market.description: Gain 120 Shimmer. Every black market offers 4 contraband items.

offer:arcAnomaly.name: Anomaly
offer:arcAnomaly.description: Pick a mutation for the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front). If that hex is empty, your strongest Digimon gets it. It lasts the whole game. Each reroll costs 1 gold.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.name: X-Antibody: Power
choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.description: X-Antibody. This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.name: X-Antibody: Guard
choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.description: X-Antibody. Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.name: X-Antibody: Mind
choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.name: X-Antibody: Bulwark
choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.description: X-Antibody. Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.name: X-Antibody: Berserk
choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.description: X-Antibody. Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.name: X-Antibody: Velocity
choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.name: X-Antibody: Ascension
choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.description: X-Antibody. After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.name: DNA Digivolution: Devour
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.name: DNA Digivolution: Share
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_power.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.name: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_energy.description: DNA Digivolution. Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.name: DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_mana.description: DNA Digivolution. Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.name: DNA Digivolution: Partners
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_partners.description: DNA Digivolution. Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.name: DNA Digivolution: Spare Body
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_familiar.description: DNA Digivolution. When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.name: DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_shield.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.name: Digital Hazard: Fireball
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_fireball.description: Digital Hazard. Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.name: Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_laser.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.name: Digital Hazard: Slime Time
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_slime.description: Digital Hazard. Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.name: Digital Hazard: Meltdown
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cooker.description: Digital Hazard. Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.name: Digital Hazard: Finisher
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_finisher.description: Digital Hazard. Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.name: Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_cuts.description: Digital Hazard. Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.name: Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_dragonsoul.description: Digital Hazard. Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.name: Digital Hazard: Last Chance
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_lastchance.description: Digital Hazard. The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.

choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.name: Digital Hazard: Thornskin
choice:arcAnomaly:dh_thorns.description: Digital Hazard. Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).

choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.name: Crest Copy
choice:arcAnomaly:u_crest.description: Utility. Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.

choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.name: Dual Wielding
choice:arcAnomaly:u_dual.description: Utility. Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

offer:arcMarket.name: Black Market
offer:arcMarket.description: Contraband only works on Kowloon Syndicate Digimon. Or pass, and your Syndicate Digimon gain permanent max HP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_gram_lance.name: Gram Lance
choice:arcMarket:arc_gram_lance.description: Deals 10% more damage, and 25% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_durandal.name: Durandal
choice:arcMarket:arc_durandal.description: Heals for 20% of all damage dealt, and heals the lowest-health ally for 10% of it.

choice:arcMarket:arc_shadow_mantle.name: Shadow Mantle
choice:arcMarket:arc_shadow_mantle.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, become untargetable for 1 second, then gain a 20% max HP shield and 15% attack speed.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crimson_fang.name: Crimson Fang
choice:arcMarket:arc_crimson_fang.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

choice:arcMarket:arc_berserk_gauntlet.name: Berserk Gauntlet
choice:arcMarket:arc_berserk_gauntlet.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, gain a 25% max HP shield and 35% AD.

choice:arcMarket:arc_ultimate_edge.name: Ultimate Edge
choice:arcMarket:arc_ultimate_edge.description: Abilities can critically strike. +10% crit damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_burning_drive.name: Burning Drive
choice:arcMarket:arc_burning_drive.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

choice:arcMarket:arc_rage_drive.name: Rage Drive
choice:arcMarket:arc_rage_drive.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

choice:arcMarket:arc_thunder_chip.name: Thunder Chip
choice:arcMarket:arc_thunder_chip.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 80 magic damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_titan_armor.name: Titan Armor
choice:arcMarket:arc_titan_armor.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

choice:arcMarket:arc_twin_arrows.name: Twin Arrows
choice:arcMarket:arc_twin_arrows.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 50% damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_fang_charm.name: Fang Charm
choice:arcMarket:arc_fang_charm.description: After casting, gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_armor_piercer.name: Armor Piercer
choice:arcMarket:arc_armor_piercer.description: Attacks cut the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crown_guard.name: Crown Guard
choice:arcMarket:arc_crown_guard.description: Start combat with a 25% max HP shield. After 8 seconds, gain 30 AP.

choice:arcMarket:arc_ionic_barrier.name: Ionic Barrier
choice:arcMarket:arc_ionic_barrier.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, deal 150 magic damage to it.

choice:arcMarket:arc_hellfire_tome.name: Hellfire Tome
choice:arcMarket:arc_hellfire_tome.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_gauntlet.name: Crest Gauntlet
choice:arcMarket:arc_crest_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +15% crit damage.

choice:arcMarket:arc_blue_card.name: Blue Card
choice:arcMarket:arc_blue_card.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana. Deals 5% more damage.

ACA.name: Witchelny Academy
ACA.description: The Academy sponsors 3 items each game. Every copy of a sponsored item gives its holder bonus max HP and damage; Academy Digimon get double. Academy Digimon also gain HP and damage on their own, and you receive a sponsored item the first time you reach each breakpoint.

AUT.name: Clockwork
AUT.description: Clockwork Digimon gain armor and magic resist. Every 12 hits they deal, they release a blast at their target for magic damage plus 25% of the damage they dealt since the last blast.

BR.name: Dark Area
BR.description: Summon a chained Belphemon at the front of your board. It breaks free after Dark Area Digimon cast 5 times or when it drops below 65% HP. It grows with the star levels of your Dark Area Digimon. With 4, Dark Area Digimon deal 15% more damage. With 5, Belphemon heals to full and erupts when freed.

SYN.name: Kowloon Syndicate
SYN.description: Syndicate Digimon gain max HP and heal for a share of the damage they deal. After each player combat you gain Shimmer (more on a losing streak of 3 or more). Every 100 Shimmer opens the black market: pick a contraband item only Syndicate Digimon can use, or pass to give Syndicate Digimon permanent max HP.

CON.name: Bagra Army
CON.description: Bagra Army Digimon gain attack damage and ability power. Their takedowns earn Conquest; every 10 Conquest opens a war chest with loot, and each chest opened gives the Bagra Army 6% more attack damage and ability power for the rest of the game.

EMI.name: Sovereign Envoys
EMI.description: Only active with exactly 1 or 4 different Envoys. Terriermon: allies gain 5% attack speed per star. Syakomon: allies restore 3 more mana per attack. Ryudamon: allies gain 10 armor and magic resist. Hackmon: Hackmon and the allies beside it gain 12% of its max HP. With 4, you get every bonus and Envoys gain 250 HP and 20% more damage.

ENF.name: DigiPolice
ENF.description: DigiPolice start combat with a shield and deal more damage. The enemies with the highest max HP are WANTED; when a Wanted enemy is knocked out, DigiPolice gain 30% attack speed.

EXP.name: Chimera Lab
EXP.description: Your strongest Chimera Lab Digimon (2, or 3 with 5) are upgraded in the Laboratory: each gains max HP and the Lab bonus of every Lab Digimon. Lab bonuses: Aruraumon, abilities deal 20% extra true damage; Crabmon, casting gives a shield and attack speed; Penguinmon, damage adds 3% of the target's max HP; Tapirmon, +200 max HP and growth on takedowns; FanBeemon, every 5th attack stings the nearest enemy for 6% of its max HP.

FAM.name: Found Family
FAM.description: Family members need less mana to cast and take 12% less damage. With 3, they also gain 20% attack speed.

FIRE.name: Firelight
FIRE.description: Every 6 seconds Firelights surge, healing a share of the damage they took since the last surge. With 3, each surge also gives 60% attack speed for 2 seconds.

MODE.name: Mode Change
MODE.description: Mode Change Digimon change form by row (always, even without the trait): in the front two rows they gain 10% max HP and their ability guards; in the back two rows they gain range 4 and their ability blasts. With the trait, front-row ones take less damage and back-row ones deal more damage.

REB.name: Digimon Rebels
REB.description: Rebels gain max HP. When your team has lost 25% of its HP, a signal flare goes up: Rebels gain 60% attack speed for 5 seconds and more attack damage and ability power for the rest of combat. With 7, the flare also stuns all enemies for 2 seconds.

SCR.name: Junkyard
SCR.description: Junkyard Digimon start combat with a shield, plus more for every component your team holds (completed items count their two). Components held by Junkyard Digimon (1, 3, then all) act as full items in combat.

HR.name: High Roller
HR.description: Each cast, BlackWarGreymon rolls a bonus: 8 rockets at random enemies, a big shield, a coin (1 gold after combat, up to 3), or a jackpot that hits its target again. It also takes 50% less damage for 1.5 seconds.

JUNK.name: Junk King
JUNK.description: Every 2 rounds while you own Chaosdromon, pick a permanent upgrade for its mech from the workshop. Owning all five gives a finishing bonus.

AMB.name: Ambusher
AMB.description: Ambushers' abilities can critically strike, and they gain critical strike chance and damage. With 5, they also take 15% less damage.

ART.name: Cannoneer
ART.description: Cannoneers gain attack damage. Every 4th attack fires a shell that hits the target and enemies next to it for 140% of their attack damage.

BRU.name: Bruiser
BRU.description: Your team gains 80 max HP. Bruisers gain a share of their max HP on top.

DOM.name: Dominator
DOM.description: Dominators start combat with a shield. When they cast, they gain ability power equal to a share of the mana spent, stacking.

PIT.name: Pit Fighter
PIT.description: Pit Fighters heal for 10% of their damage and deal bonus true damage. Once per combat at 50% HP, they heal a share of their max HP over 2 seconds.

QS.name: Quickstriker
QS.description: Quickstrikers gain attack speed based on their target's missing HP. With 4, a takedown also gives them a 200 HP shield.

SEN.name: Sentinel
SEN.description: Your team gains armor and magic resist. Sentinels gain triple.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage, and more again for each hex between them and their target.

SOR.name: Sorcerer
SOR.description: Your team gains 8 ability power. Sorcerers gain more. With 6, their abilities make the target deal 20% less damage for 3 seconds.

VIS.name: Visionary
VIS.description: Visionaries gain more mana from attacks and from damage taken. With 6, their ability damage heals the lowest-health ally for 16% of it.

WAT.name: Watcher
WAT.description: Watchers take less damage, more while above 50% HP.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

arc_a_training.name: Combat Training
arc_a_training.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

arc_a_wind.name: Second Wind
arc_a_wind.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of missing HP.

arc_a_feather.name: Featherweights
arc_a_feather.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Digimon gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_front.name: Frontline Fortitude
arc_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor, 30 MR and 200 HP.

arc_a_back.name: Backline Barrage
arc_a_back.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

arc_a_shimmer.name: Syndicate Ties
arc_a_shimmer.description: Gain 60 Shimmer and a Mushroomon. Your Syndicate Digimon gain 150 HP.

arc_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
arc_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

arc_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
arc_a_evolve.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

arc_a_blessing.name: Celestial Blessing
arc_a_blessing.description: Your team heals for 12% of damage dealt.

arc_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
arc_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

arc_a_overcharge.name: Overcharged
arc_a_overcharge.description: Your team starts combat with 25 extra mana.

arc_a_find.name: Golden Find
arc_a_find.description: Gain 6 free rerolls now. Your Anomaly Digimon drops 1 gold for every 3 knockouts it scores.

arc_a_unity.name: Stand United
arc_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP per active trait.

arc_a_crown.name: Crowned
arc_a_crown.description: Gain a Tamer's Crown (+1 team size).

arc_a_mega.name: Mega Digivolve
arc_a_mega.description: Gain a random Champion-form (2-star) Digimon of cost 4.

arc_a_mutant.name: Double Mutation
arc_a_mutant.description: You get a second Anomaly pick, for a different Digimon, the round after your first. Gain 6 gold.

arc_a_market.name: Black Market Pass
arc_a_market.description: Gain 120 Shimmer. Every black market offers 4 contraband items.

offer:arcAnomaly.name: Anomaly
offer:arcAnomaly.description: Pick a mutation for the Digimon on your center hex (column 4, second row from the front). If that hex is empty, your strongest Digimon gets it. It lasts the whole game. Each reroll costs 1 gold.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.name: X-Antibody: Power
choice:arcAnomaly:x_power.description: X-Antibody. This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.name: X-Antibody: Guard
choice:arcAnomaly:x_guard.description: X-Antibody. Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.name: X-Antibody: Mind
choice:arcAnomaly:x_mind.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.name: X-Antibody: Bulwark
choice:arcAnomaly:x_bulwark.description: X-Antibody. Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.name: X-Antibody: Berserk
choice:arcAnomaly:x_berserk.description: X-Antibody. Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.name: X-Antibody: Velocity
choice:arcAnomaly:x_velocity.description: X-Antibody. Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.

choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.name: X-Antibody: Ascension
choice:arcAnomaly:x_ascend.description: X-Antibody. After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.name: DNA Digivolution: Devour
choice:arcAnomaly:dna_hunger.description: DNA Digivolution. At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.

choice:arcAnomaly:dna_share.name: DNA Digivolution: Share

col_ar_doom.name: Doom Grasp
col_ar_doom.description: At the start of combat, and every 13 seconds, blasts the nearest enemy for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

col_ar_collector.name: Gold Collector
col_ar_collector.description: Damage finishes off enemies below 12% HP.

col_ar_lichbane.name: Lich Bane
col_ar_lichbane.description: The first attack after each cast deals 100 + 60 per stage bonus magic damage.

col_ar_hull.name: Hull Crusher
col_ar_hull.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

col_ar_static.name: Static Shiv
col_ar_static.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 120 magic damage.

col_ar_hydra.name: Titanic Hydra
col_ar_hydra.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 40% damage.

col_ar_zhonya.name: Zhonya Paradox
col_ar_zhonya.description: Once per combat at 40% HP, become untouchable for 2.5 seconds.

col_core.name: Digi-Core
col_core.description: Drag onto a Digimon to pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. A new path replaces the old one. Selling that Digimon gives the Digi-Core back.

col_extractor.name: Data Extractor
col_extractor.description: Drag onto a Digimon to remove its digivolution path and get its Digi-Core back.

col_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
col_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

col_reforger.name: Reforger
col_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

consumable:col_core.name: Digi-Core
consumable:col_core.description: Pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. A new path replaces the old one. Selling that Digimon gives the Digi-Core back.

consumable:col_extractor.name: Data Extractor
consumable:col_extractor.description: Remove its digivolution path and get its Digi-Core back.

BA.name: Digi Academy
BA.description: Academy students train their Potential. Each point of Potential makes their abilities deal 9% more damage and gives 50 max HP.

CG.name: Jewel Gambit
CG.description: Jewel Gambit Digimon gain max HP and deal more damage. Kills and losses in player combats earn Gem Power. Every 3 player combats, cash the gems out for gold and items, or Double Down: losses then earn twice as much, but a win halves your Gem Power and cashes out at once.

MEN.name: Sensei
MEN.description: Active only with exactly 1 or 4 different Sensei. With 1, your whole team gains that Sensei's lesson. With 4, the Sensei gain every lesson and 10 ability power. Lessons: Jijimon line 6% less damage taken, Kentaurosmon line 8% attack damage and ability power, Grademon line 10% attack speed, Piximon line 2 extra mana per attack.

MECH.name: Mega Mech
MECH.description: Machinedramon joins the fight in your front row. Its HP and attack grow with the star levels of your Mega Mech Digimon, and they heal it for 12% of the damage they deal. With 5 and 7 it gets Blade Protocol upgrades.

MT.name: Monster Tamer
MT.description: When you get Labramon, pick which partner it fights alongside as: Ballistamon (tank), Dorulumon (diver) or Sparrowmon (ranged attacker).

RC.name: Pirate Captain
RC.description: While Piedmon is on your board, you draw a Bounty card at the start of each round: gold, rerolls, components, ability power for Piedmon or a shield for your team. Bounties get better the longer Piedmon stays fielded. Street Crew allies deal 12% of their damage again as true damage.

RM.name: Rose Queen
RM.description: Lotosmon brings two plants: a Woodmon root in front of her and a Togemon spine behind her (four at three stars). When Lotosmon casts, her plants heal 35% HP and gain 35% attack speed; dead plants grow back.

SF.name: Spirit Fighters
SF.description: Spirit Fighters gain max HP, and every second gain attack damage and ability power, up to 8 times. At 8 stacks they deal extra true damage.

SM.name: Stance Master
SM.description: When you get Justimon, pick an arm: Blitz Arm (Duelist), Critical Arm (Executioner) or Trinity Arm (Juggernaut). The arm changes its ability and gives it that trait.

SG.name: Star Wards
SG.description: Every Star Ward line on your board adds its own bonus for all Star Wards, and more Star Wards make every bonus stronger. Starmon line: 150 shield. Sorcermon line: 4 AP every 3 seconds. Aquilamon line: every 3rd attack deals bonus magic damage. Taomon line: 15 mana after casting. Sunflowmon line: 10% stronger healing and shields for your team. Monzaemon line: heal 25% HP once at 40% HP. Rapidmon line: 12% attack speed. Ophanimon line: 25 armor and MR, 100 HP and 8% AD, AS and crit.

SC.name: Supreme Virus
SC.description: The Supreme Virus Digimon that dealt the most damage in your last combat is Supreme. Supreme Virus Digimon deal more damage; the Supreme one deals even more and finishes off enemies below 10% HP. When it falls, the one with the most damage so far takes over. With 4, two are Supreme.

CH.name: The Champ
CH.description: Each player combat Craniamon wins brings fans equal to its star level. When you lose a player combat, each fan blocks 1 damage to you, then all fans leave.

CREW.name: Street Crew
CREW.description: Street Crew Digimon gain max HP and attack speed. Every 400 damage they deal launches a rocket at a random enemy. Each three-star Street Crew Digimon gives you a free reroll every round.

WR.name: Phantoms
WR.description: Every 4 seconds the Shadow Realm strikes the 3 enemies nearest your Phantoms for a share of the damage your Phantoms dealt since the last strike. Your lowest-health Phantom heals for 18% of that damage.

LU.name: Luchadors
LU.description: Luchadors gain attack damage. The first time one drops below 50% HP, it shakes off stuns, heals and slams down, stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second.

BAS.name: Bastion
BAS.description: Your team gains 6 armor and MR. Bastions gain more, doubled for the first 10 seconds of combat. With 6, the rest of your team gains 25 more.

DUE.name: Duelist
DUE.description: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed, stacking up to 12 times. With 6, Duelists also take 12% less damage.

EDG.name: Swordmaster
EDG.description: Swordmasters gain attack damage and omnivamp. While attacking an enemy below 50% HP they gain 40% attack speed.

EXE.name: Executioner
EXE.description: Executioners gain critical strike chance and critical damage, and their abilities can critically strike.

HEV.name: Heavyweight
HEV.description: Your team gains 60 HP. Heavyweights gain more max HP and attack damage equal to a share of their max HP.

JUG.name: Juggernaut
JUG.description: Juggernauts take less damage, 8% less again while above 50% HP. When a Juggernaut falls, the others heal 10% of their max HP.

PRO.name: Prodigy
PRO.description: Your team gains 1 mana every second. Prodigies gain more. With 5, damage from Prodigy abilities heals your lowest-health ally for 12% of it.

PRT.name: Protector
PRT.description: Protectors take 5% less damage while shielded. The first time one drops below 50% HP, it shields itself and its nearest ally for a share of its max HP.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage, and more again for each hex between them and their target.

SOR.name: Sorcerer
SOR.description: Sorcerers gain ability power. When an enemy a Sorcerer damaged falls, another enemy takes magic damage equal to a share of its max HP (two enemies with 6).

STR.name: Strategist
STR.description: At the start of combat, allies in your front two rows gain a shield and allies in your back two rows deal more damage. Strategists gain triple.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

col_a_warmup.name: Warm-Up
col_a_warmup.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

col_a_front.name: Front Row Seats
col_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor and MR and 200 HP.

col_a_ringside.name: Ringside Snipers
col_a_ringside.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

col_a_snack.name: Extra Snack
col_a_snack.description: Gain a Digi-Core and a random component.

col_a_second.name: Second Wind
col_a_second.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of its missing HP.

col_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
col_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

col_a_ascension.name: Ascension
col_a_ascension.description: After 15 seconds of combat, your team deals 40% more damage.

col_a_crest.name: Gym Crest
col_a_crest.description: Gain a random Crest for a trait on your board.

col_a_tags.name: Tag Team
col_a_tags.description: Gain a Crest Tag and a Digi-Egg.

col_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
col_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

col_a_unity.name: Stand United
col_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP for every active trait.

col_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
col_a_evolve.description: Gain a random two-star Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

col_a_golden.name: Golden Egg
col_a_golden.description: Gain a Golden Digi-Egg (+1 team size).

col_a_feast.name: Digi-Core Feast
col_a_feast.description: Gain 2 Digi-Cores and a random completed item.

col_a_arena.name: Spirit of the Arena
col_a_arena.description: Every active origin trait counts one extra Digimon.

col_a_finals.name: Finals Night
col_a_finals.description: Your team deals 12% more damage and takes 10% less damage.

offer:col_core.name: Digi-Core
offer:col_core.description: Pick a digivolution path. It stays when the Digimon digivolves.

choice:col_core:burst.name: Burst Mode
choice:col_core:burst.description: Deals 12% more damage, 25% more after its first takedown each combat.

choice:col_core:xanti.name: X-Antibody
choice:col_core:xanti.description: When hit, gains 4 armor (physical) or 8 MR (magic), up to 90 in total.

choice:col_core:dark.name: Dark Digivolution
choice:col_core:dark.description: Gains 22% attack damage and 10% omnivamp, but loses 1% max HP every second.

choice:col_core:warp.name: Warp Digivolution
choice:col_core:warp.description: Gains 8% attack damage, 8 AP, 10 armor and MR, and deals 5% more damage.

choice:col_core:armor.name: Armor Digivolution
choice:col_core:armor.description: Starts combat with a 25% max HP shield. While shielded, gains 30% attack speed.

choice:col_core:mode.name: Mode Change
choice:col_core:mode.description: At the start of combat, it and its nearest ally gain an 18% max HP shield.

choice:col_core:slide.name: Slide Evolution
choice:col_core:slide.description: When it switches targets, its next attack deals 120% bonus damage as magic damage.

choice:col_core:spirit.name: Spirit Evolution
choice:col_core:spirit.description: The first time it drops below 40% HP, heals 25% max HP and gains 25% attack speed.

choice:col_core:deathx.name: Death-X Evolution
choice:col_core:deathx.description: Leaps to the enemy backline at the start of combat and gains 30% crit chance and 10% crit damage.

choice:col_core:biomerge.name: Biomerge
choice:col_core:biomerge.description: Gains 3% attack damage and 3 AP every second, up to 30 times.

choice:col_core:overwrite.name: Overwrite
choice:col_core:overwrite.description: Gains 30% crit chance and 15% crit damage; its abilities can critically strike.

choice:col_core:matrix.name: Matrix Evolution
choice:col_core:matrix.description: Its max mana is 25% lower and it starts combat with 10 extra mana.

choice:col_core:overdrive.name: Overdrive
choice:col_core:overdrive.description: Deals 12% more damage. After its first takedown or 10 seconds of combat, stuns enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds and deals 20% more damage for the rest of combat.

choice:col_core:atomic.name: Atomic Core
choice:col_core:atomic.description: Stores 10% max HP at the start of combat and 2% more every second. When it falls, deals the stored amount as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.

choice:col_core:thorn.name: Thorn Armor
choice:col_core:thorn.description: When attacked, deals 50 + 5% of its max HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).

choice:col_core:glacier.name: Glacier Mode
choice:col_core:glacier.description: Gains 15% attack speed. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

choice:col_core:inferno.name: Inferno Mode
choice:col_core:inferno.description: Its abilities burn their targets, and it deals 15% more damage to burning enemies.

choice:col_core:hunter.name: Hunter Mode
choice:col_core:hunter.description: Deals 8% more damage, and 30% more to enemies below 50% HP.

choice:col_core:guardian.name: Guardian Mode
choice:col_core:guardian.description: Gains 30 armor and MR. Adjacent allies gain 10 armor and MR.

choice:col_core:ascend.name: Ascension
choice:col_core:ascend.description: After 6 seconds of combat, deals 40% more damage.

offer:col_form.name: Choose a form
offer:col_form.description: Pick how this Digimon fights. The choice stays when it digivolves.

choice:col_form:blitz.name: Blitz Arm
choice:col_form:blitz.description: Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.

choice:col_form:critical.name: Critical Arm
choice:col_form:critical.description: Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.

choice:col_form:trinity.name: Trinity Arm
choice:col_form:trinity.description: Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.

choice:col_form:ballista.name: Ballistamon
choice:col_form:ballista.description: Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.

choice:col_form:dorulu.name: Dorulumon
choice:col_form:dorulu.description: Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.

choice:col_form:sparrow.name: Sparrowmon
choice:col_form:sparrow.description: Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.

offer:col_gambit.name: Jewel Gambit
offer:col_gambit.description: Cash out your Gem Power now, or Double Down for the next 3 player combats.

col_titan_slayer.name: Titan Slayer
col_titan_slayer.description: Deals 8% more damage, and 25% more to enemies with over 1600 max HP.

col_data_gunblade.name: Data Gunblade
col_data_gunblade.description: Heals for 18% of damage dealt. Also heals the lowest-health ally for 15% of damage dealt.

col_night_cloak.name: Night Cloak
col_night_cloak.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, become untouchable for 1 second, shake off stuns and gain 25% attack speed.

col_blood_fang.name: Blood Fang
col_blood_fang.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt. Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield once.

col_sterak_gauntlet.name: Sterak Gauntlet
col_sterak_gauntlet.description: The first time HP drops below 60%, gain a 40% max HP shield and 30% attack damage.

col_crit_edge.name: Crit Edge
col_crit_edge.description: Abilities can critically strike. +10% crit damage.

col_red_fang.name: Red Fang
col_red_fang.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

col_rage_rod.name: Rage Rod
col_rage_rod.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking.

col_void_staff.name: Void Staff
col_void_staff.description: Damage cuts the target's MR by 30% for 5 seconds.

col_titan_will.name: Titan Will
col_titan_will.description: Attacking or being attacked grants 2% AD and 2 AP, up to 25 stacks.

col_armor_breaker.name: Armor Breaker
col_armor_breaker.description: Attacks cut the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds.

col_crown_guard.name: Crown Guard
col_crown_guard.description: Start combat with a 25% max HP shield. After 8 seconds, gain 30 AP.

col_ion_spark.name: Ion Spark
col_ion_spark.description: When an enemy within 2 hexes casts, deal 150 magic damage to it. Enemies within 2 hexes lose 15 armor and MR.

col_flame_tome.name: Flame Tome
col_flame_tome.description: Damage burns the target for 1.5% max HP per second and cuts its healing by a third.

col_jewel_gauntlet.name: Jewel Gauntlet
col_jewel_gauntlet.description: Abilities can critically strike. +15% crit damage.

col_blue_card.name: Blue Card
col_blue_card.description: Max mana -10. After casting, keep 20 mana.

col_guardian_vow.name: Guardian Vow
col_guardian_vow.description: Below 40% HP, gain a 25% max HP shield and 15 mana once.

col_adaptive_helm.name: Adaptive Helm
col_adaptive_helm.description: Gain 10 mana every 3 seconds. In the front two rows, gain 25 armor and MR; in the back two rows, gain 15% AD and 15 AP.

col_justice_hand.name: Justice Hand
col_justice_hand.description: Deals 12% more damage and heals for 12% of damage dealt.

col_bramble_plate.name: Bramble Plate
col_bramble_plate.description: Takes 6% less damage. When attacked, deals 80 magic damage to adjacent enemies (1.5s cooldown).

col_gargoyle_stone.name: Gargoyle Stone
col_gargoyle_stone.description: Gain 10 armor and MR for each enemy within 2 hexes.

col_sunfire_core.name: Sunfire Core
col_sunfire_core.description: Every 2 seconds, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes.

col_steadfast_heart.name: Steadfast Heart
col_steadfast_heart.description: Takes 10% less damage, 18% less while above 50% HP.

col_even_shroud.name: Even Shroud
col_even_shroud.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and MR. Gain 25 armor and MR for the first 15 seconds.

col_quick_silver.name: Quick Silver
col_quick_silver.description: Immune to stuns for the first 18 seconds. Each attack grants 2% attack speed, stacking.

col_striker_flail.name: Striker Flail
col_striker_flail.description: Critical strikes make the holder deal 5% more damage for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

col_thief_glove.name: Thief Glove
col_thief_glove.description: Each combat, gains two random completed items.

col_golden_egg.name: Golden Digi-Egg
col_golden_egg.description: +1 team size while held by a Digimon on your board.

col_golden_tag.name: Golden Tag
col_golden_tag.description: +1 team size while held by a Digimon on your board.

col_digivice.name: Digivice
col_digivice.description: +1 team size while held by a Digimon on your board.

col_egg.name: Digi-Egg
col_egg.description: Combine with a component to make an origin Crest. Two Digi-Eggs make a Golden Digi-Egg; with a Crest Tag it makes a Digivice.

col_tag.name: Crest Tag
col_tag.description: Combine with a component to make a class Crest. Two Crest Tags make a Golden Tag.

col_cr_ba.name: Digi Academy Crest
col_cr_ba.description: The holder gains the Digi Academy trait.

col_cr_cg.name: Jewel Gambit Crest
col_cr_cg.description: The holder gains the Jewel Gambit trait.

col_cr_lu.name: Luchadors Crest
col_cr_lu.description: The holder gains the Luchadors trait.

col_cr_sf.name: Spirit Fighters Crest
col_cr_sf.description: The holder gains the Spirit Fighters trait.

col_cr_sg.name: Star Wards Crest
col_cr_sg.description: The holder gains the Star Wards trait.

col_cr_str.name: Strategist Crest
col_cr_str.description: The holder gains the Strategist trait.

col_cr_sc.name: Supreme Virus Crest
col_cr_sc.description: The holder gains the Supreme Virus trait.

col_cr_wr.name: Phantoms Crest
col_cr_wr.description: The holder gains the Phantoms trait.

col_cr_bas.name: Bastion Crest
col_cr_bas.description: The holder gains the Bastion trait.

col_cr_due.name: Duelist Crest
col_cr_due.description: The holder gains the Duelist trait.

col_cr_edg.name: Swordmaster Crest
col_cr_edg.description: The holder gains the Swordmaster trait.

col_cr_exe.name: Executioner Crest
col_cr_exe.description: The holder gains the Executioner trait.

col_cr_hev.name: Heavyweight Crest
col_cr_hev.description: The holder gains the Heavyweight trait.

col_cr_jug.name: Juggernaut Crest
col_cr_jug.description: The holder gains the Juggernaut trait.

col_cr_pro.name: Prodigy Crest
col_cr_pro.description: The holder gains the Prodigy trait.

col_cr_sor.name: Sorcerer Crest
col_cr_sor.description: The holder gains the Sorcerer trait.

col_cr_prt.name: Protector Crest
col_cr_prt.description: The holder gains the Protector trait.

col_cr_sni.name: Sniper Crest
col_cr_sni.description: The holder gains the Sniper trait.

col_ar_doom.name: Doom Grasp
col_ar_doom.description: At the start of combat, and every 13 seconds, blasts the nearest enemy for 25% of its max HP as magic damage.

col_ar_collector.name: Gold Collector
col_ar_collector.description: Damage finishes off enemies below 12% HP.

col_ar_lichbane.name: Lich Bane
col_ar_lichbane.description: The first attack after each cast deals 100 + 60 per stage bonus magic damage.

col_ar_hull.name: Hull Crusher
col_ar_hull.description: If no ally is adjacent at the start of combat, gain 600 HP, 20% AD and 20 AP.

col_ar_static.name: Static Shiv
col_ar_static.description: Every 3rd attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 120 magic damage.

col_ar_hydra.name: Titanic Hydra
col_ar_hydra.description: Attacks also hit a second nearby enemy for 40% damage.

col_ar_zhonya.name: Zhonya Paradox
col_ar_zhonya.description: Once per combat at 40% HP, become untouchable for 2.5 seconds.

col_core.name: Digi-Core
col_core.description: Drag onto a Digimon to pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. A new path replaces the old one. Selling that Digimon gives the Digi-Core back.

col_extractor.name: Data Extractor
col_extractor.description: Drag onto a Digimon to remove its digivolution path and get its Digi-Core back.

col_remover.name: Magnetic Remover
col_remover.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return all of its items to your item bench.

col_reforger.name: Reforger
col_reforger.description: Drag onto a Digimon to return its items to your bench as random new items of the same kind.

consumable:col_core.name: Digi-Core
consumable:col_core.description: Pick 1 of 3 digivolution paths for it. A new path replaces the old one. Selling that Digimon gives the Digi-Core back.

consumable:col_extractor.name: Data Extractor
consumable:col_extractor.description: Remove its digivolution path and get its Digi-Core back.

BA.name: Digi Academy
BA.description: Academy students train their Potential. Each point of Potential makes their abilities deal 9% more damage and gives 50 max HP.

CG.name: Jewel Gambit
CG.description: Jewel Gambit Digimon gain max HP and deal more damage. Kills and losses in player combats earn Gem Power. Every 3 player combats, cash the gems out for gold and items, or Double Down: losses then earn twice as much, but a win halves your Gem Power and cashes out at once.

MEN.name: Sensei
MEN.description: Active only with exactly 1 or 4 different Sensei. With 1, your whole team gains that Sensei's lesson. With 4, the Sensei gain every lesson and 10 ability power. Lessons: Jijimon line 6% less damage taken, Kentaurosmon line 8% attack damage and ability power, Grademon line 10% attack speed, Piximon line 2 extra mana per attack.

MECH.name: Mega Mech
MECH.description: Machinedramon joins the fight in your front row. Its HP and attack grow with the star levels of your Mega Mech Digimon, and they heal it for 12% of the damage they deal. With 5 and 7 it gets Blade Protocol upgrades.

MT.name: Monster Tamer
MT.description: When you get Labramon, pick which partner it fights alongside as: Ballistamon (tank), Dorulumon (diver) or Sparrowmon (ranged attacker).

RC.name: Pirate Captain
RC.description: While Piedmon is on your board, you draw a Bounty card at the start of each round: gold, rerolls, components, ability power for Piedmon or a shield for your team. Bounties get better the longer Piedmon stays fielded. Street Crew allies deal 12% of their damage again as true damage.

RM.name: Rose Queen
RM.description: Lotosmon brings two plants: a Woodmon root in front of her and a Togemon spine behind her (four at three stars). When Lotosmon casts, her plants heal 35% HP and gain 35% attack speed; dead plants grow back.

SF.name: Spirit Fighters
SF.description: Spirit Fighters gain max HP, and every second gain attack damage and ability power, up to 8 times. At 8 stacks they deal extra true damage.

SM.name: Stance Master
SM.description: When you get Justimon, pick an arm: Blitz Arm (Duelist), Critical Arm (Executioner) or Trinity Arm (Juggernaut). The arm changes its ability and gives it that trait.

SG.name: Star Wards
SG.description: Every Star Ward line on your board adds its own bonus for all Star Wards, and more Star Wards make every bonus stronger. Starmon line: 150 shield. Sorcermon line: 4 AP every 3 seconds. Aquilamon line: every 3rd attack deals bonus magic damage. Taomon line: 15 mana after casting. Sunflowmon line: 10% stronger healing and shields for your team. Monzaemon line: heal 25% HP once at 40% HP. Rapidmon line: 12% attack speed. Ophanimon line: 25 armor and MR, 100 HP and 8% AD, AS and crit.

SC.name: Supreme Virus
SC.description: The Supreme Virus Digimon that dealt the most damage in your last combat is Supreme. Supreme Virus Digimon deal more damage; the Supreme one deals even more and finishes off enemies below 10% HP. When it falls, the one with the most damage so far takes over. With 4, two are Supreme.

CH.name: The Champ
CH.description: Each player combat Craniamon wins brings fans equal to its star level. When you lose a player combat, each fan blocks 1 damage to you, then all fans leave.

CREW.name: Street Crew
CREW.description: Street Crew Digimon gain max HP and attack speed. Every 400 damage they deal launches a rocket at a random enemy. Each three-star Street Crew Digimon gives you a free reroll every round.

WR.name: Phantoms
WR.description: Every 4 seconds the Shadow Realm strikes the 3 enemies nearest your Phantoms for a share of the damage your Phantoms dealt since the last strike. Your lowest-health Phantom heals for 18% of that damage.

LU.name: Luchadors
LU.description: Luchadors gain attack damage. The first time one drops below 50% HP, it shakes off stuns, heals and slams down, stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second.

BAS.name: Bastion
BAS.description: Your team gains 6 armor and MR. Bastions gain more, doubled for the first 10 seconds of combat. With 6, the rest of your team gains 25 more.

DUE.name: Duelist
DUE.description: Each basic attack gives a Duelist attack speed, stacking up to 12 times. With 6, Duelists also take 12% less damage.

EDG.name: Swordmaster
EDG.description: Swordmasters gain attack damage and omnivamp. While attacking an enemy below 50% HP they gain 40% attack speed.

EXE.name: Executioner
EXE.description: Executioners gain critical strike chance and critical damage, and their abilities can critically strike.

HEV.name: Heavyweight
HEV.description: Your team gains 60 HP. Heavyweights gain more max HP and attack damage equal to a share of their max HP.

JUG.name: Juggernaut
JUG.description: Juggernauts take less damage, 8% less again while above 50% HP. When a Juggernaut falls, the others heal 10% of their max HP.

PRO.name: Prodigy
PRO.description: Your team gains 1 mana every second. Prodigies gain more. With 5, damage from Prodigy abilities heals your lowest-health ally for 12% of it.

PRT.name: Protector
PRT.description: Protectors take 5% less damage while shielded. The first time one drops below 50% HP, it shields itself and its nearest ally for a share of its max HP.

SNI.name: Sniper
SNI.description: Snipers deal more damage, and more again for each hex between them and their target.

SOR.name: Sorcerer
SOR.description: Sorcerers gain ability power. When an enemy a Sorcerer damaged falls, another enemy takes magic damage equal to a share of its max HP (two enemies with 6).

STR.name: Strategist
STR.description: At the start of combat, allies in your front two rows gain a shield and allies in your back two rows deal more damage. Strategists gain triple.

trait:BA:0.description: 3 Potential: abilities deal 27% more damage, +150 max HP

trait:BA:1.description: 5 Potential: abilities deal 45% more damage, +250 max HP

trait:BA:2.description: 7 Potential: abilities deal 63% more damage, +350 max HP

trait:CG:0.description: +80 HP, +4% damage. Earn Gem Power from kills and losses

trait:CG:1.description: +150 HP, +9% damage. Also: every 8 kills, gain a component (the count then rolls 6-10)

trait:CG:2.description: +280 HP, +18% damage. Also: every 8 kills a component; cash-outs are worth 30% more

trait:MEN:0.description: Exactly 1 Sensei: your whole team gains its lesson

trait:MEN:1.description: Exactly 4 Sensei: the Sensei gain every lesson and 10 ability power

trait:MECH:1.description: Blade Protocol 1: Machinedramon gains 15% attack damage and its attacks also hit a second enemy for 30%

trait:MECH:2.description: Blade Protocol 2: also 25% omnivamp and 20% less damage taken

trait:RC:0.description: Draw a Bounty card every round; Street Crew deal 12% extra true damage

trait:RM:0.description: Lotosmon brings 2 plants (4 at three stars)

trait:SF:0.description: +150 HP, +2.5% AD/AP per second, 12% true damage at 8 stacks

trait:SF:1.description: +300 HP, +4% AD/AP per second, 18% true damage at 8 stacks

trait:SF:2.description: +500 HP, +6% AD/AP per second, 25% true damage at 8 stacks

trait:SC:0.description: +10% damage; the Supreme deals +12% and finishes enemies below 10% HP

trait:SC:1.description: +24% damage; the Supreme deals +32% and finishes enemies below 10% HP

trait:SC:2.description: +30% damage; the Supreme deals +50% and finishes enemies below 10% HP; two Supremes

trait:CH:0.description: Wins bring fans; fans block damage on a loss

trait:CREW:0.description: +4% max HP and attack speed; rockets every 400 damage
