duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

col_a_warmup.name: Warm-Up
col_a_warmup.description: Your team gains 12% AD and 12 AP.

col_a_front.name: Front Row Seats
col_a_front.description: Digimon in your front row gain 30 armor and MR and 200 HP.

col_a_ringside.name: Ringside Snipers
col_a_ringside.description: Digimon in your back two rows gain 25% attack speed.

col_a_snack.name: Extra Snack
col_a_snack.description: Gain a Digi-Core and a random component.

col_a_second.name: Second Wind
col_a_second.description: After 10 seconds of combat, your team heals 35% of its missing HP.

col_a_trove.name: Treasure Trove
col_a_trove.description: Gain a random completed item and a component.

col_a_ascension.name: Ascension
col_a_ascension.description: After 15 seconds of combat, your team deals 40% more damage.

col_a_crest.name: Gym Crest
col_a_crest.description: Gain a random Crest for a trait on your board.

col_a_tags.name: Tag Team
col_a_tags.description: Gain a Crest Tag and a Digi-Egg.

col_a_lotus.name: Jeweled Lotus
col_a_lotus.description: Your abilities can critically strike, and your team gains 15% crit.

col_a_unity.name: Stand United
col_a_unity.description: Your team gains 3% AD and 3 AP for every active trait.

col_a_evolve.name: Instant Digivolve
col_a_evolve.description: Gain a random two-star Digimon of cost 2 or 3.

col_a_golden.name: Golden Egg
col_a_golden.description: Gain a Golden Digi-Egg (+1 team size).

col_a_feast.name: Digi-Core Feast
col_a_feast.description: Gain 2 Digi-Cores and a random completed item.

col_a_arena.name: Spirit of the Arena
col_a_arena.description: Every active origin trait counts one extra Digimon.

col_a_finals.name: Finals Night
col_a_finals.description: Your team deals 12% more damage and takes 10% less damage.

offer:col_core.name: Digi-Core
offer:col_core.description: Pick a digivolution path. It stays when the Digimon digivolves.

choice:col_core:burst.name: Burst Mode
choice:col_core:burst.description: Deals 12% more damage, 25% more after its first takedown each combat.

choice:col_core:xanti.name: X-Antibody
choice:col_core:xanti.description: When hit, gains 4 armor (physical) or 8 MR (magic), up to 90 in total.

choice:col_core:dark.name: Dark Digivolution
choice:col_core:dark.description: Gains 22% attack damage and 10% omnivamp, but loses 1% max HP every second.

choice:col_core:warp.name: Warp Digivolution
choice:col_core:warp.description: Gains 8% attack damage, 8 AP, 10 armor and MR, and deals 5% more damage.

choice:col_core:armor.name: Armor Digivolution
choice:col_core:armor.description: Starts combat with a 25% max HP shield. While shielded, gains 30% attack speed.

choice:col_core:mode.name: Mode Change
choice:col_core:mode.description: At the start of combat, it and its nearest ally gain an 18% max HP shield.

choice:col_core:slide.name: Slide Evolution
choice:col_core:slide.description: When it switches targets, its next attack deals 120% bonus damage as magic damage.

choice:col_core:spirit.name: Spirit Evolution
choice:col_core:spirit.description: The first time it drops below 40% HP, heals 25% max HP and gains 25% attack speed.

choice:col_core:deathx.name: Death-X Evolution
choice:col_core:deathx.description: Leaps to the enemy backline at the start of combat and gains 30% crit chance and 10% crit damage.

choice:col_core:biomerge.name: Biomerge
choice:col_core:biomerge.description: Gains 3% attack damage and 3 AP every second, up to 30 times.

choice:col_core:overwrite.name: Overwrite
choice:col_core:overwrite.description: Gains 30% crit chance and 15% crit damage; its abilities can critically strike.

choice:col_core:matrix.name: Matrix Evolution
choice:col_core:matrix.description: Its max mana is 25% lower and it starts combat with 10 extra mana.

choice:col_core:overdrive.name: Overdrive
choice:col_core:overdrive.description: Deals 12% more damage. After its first takedown or 10 seconds of combat, stuns enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds and deals 20% more damage for the rest of combat.

choice:col_core:atomic.name: Atomic Core
choice:col_core:atomic.description: Stores 10% max HP at the start of combat and 2% more every second. When it falls, deals the stored amount as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.

choice:col_core:thorn.name: Thorn Armor
choice:col_core:thorn.description: When attacked, deals 50 + 5% of its max HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).

choice:col_core:glacier.name: Glacier Mode
choice:col_core:glacier.description: Gains 15% attack speed. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

choice:col_core:inferno.name: Inferno Mode
choice:col_core:inferno.description: Its abilities burn their targets, and it deals 15% more damage to burning enemies.

choice:col_core:hunter.name: Hunter Mode
choice:col_core:hunter.description: Deals 8% more damage, and 30% more to enemies below 50% HP.

choice:col_core:guardian.name: Guardian Mode
choice:col_core:guardian.description: Gains 30 armor and MR. Adjacent allies gain 10 armor and MR.

choice:col_core:ascend.name: Ascension
choice:col_core:ascend.description: After 6 seconds of combat, deals 40% more damage.

offer:col_form.name: Choose a form
offer:col_form.description: Pick how this Digimon fights. The choice stays when it digivolves.

choice:col_form:blitz.name: Blitz Arm
choice:col_form:blitz.description: Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.

choice:col_form:critical.name: Critical Arm
choice:col_form:critical.description: Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.

choice:col_form:trinity.name: Trinity Arm
choice:col_form:trinity.description: Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.

choice:col_form:ballista.name: Ballistamon
choice:col_form:ballista.description: Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.

choice:col_form:dorulu.name: Dorulumon
choice:col_form:dorulu.description: Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.

choice:col_form:sparrow.name: Sparrowmon
choice:col_form:sparrow.description: Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.

offer:col_gambit.name: Jewel Gambit
offer:col_gambit.description: Cash out your Gem Power now, or Double Down for the next 3 player combats.

ul_headdress.name: Headdress
ul_headdress.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it regenerate 20 HP per second.

ul_hood.name: Hood of Defiance
ul_hood.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it gain 25 magic resist.

ul_vitality.name: Vitality Booster
ul_vitality.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it gain 200 max HP.

ul_arcane.name: Arcane Boots
ul_arcane.description: Every 10 seconds, if the holder has over half its mana, allies within 2 hexes gain 20 mana.

ul_armlet.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
ul_armlet.description: +60% attack damage and +25 armor. The holder loses 3% of its max HP every second (it cannot fall below 1 HP from this).

ul_blademail.name: Blade Mail
ul_blademail.description: +15 armor. Returns 20% of damage taken to the attacker.

ul_blink.name: Blink Dagger
ul_blink.description: At the start of combat and every 15 seconds, teleports next to the farthest enemy and gains 45 mana.

ul_desolator.name: Desolator
ul_desolator.description: +10% attack damage. Attacks cut the target's armor by 15 for 5 seconds.

ul_lance.name: Dragon Lance
ul_lance.description: Ranged holders only: +25% attack damage and 3 more range.

ul_halberd.name: Heaven's Halberd
ul_halberd.description: 20% dodge chance. Every 10 seconds, an attack slows the target's attack speed by 60% for 3 seconds.

ul_paladin.name: Paladin Sword
ul_paladin.description: +20% attack damage. All healing on your team is 20% stronger.

ul_quelling.name: Quelling Blade
ul_quelling.description: +20% attack damage. Deals double damage to summoned units.

ul_stonecloak.name: Stonehall Cloak
ul_stonecloak.description: +150 max HP. Each knockout gives 100 max HP and heals 100 for the rest of combat.

ul_stonepike.name: Stonehall Pike
ul_stonepike.description: +10% attack damage. Each knockout gives 10% attack damage for the rest of combat.

ul_vanguard.name: Vanguard
ul_vanguard.description: +350 max HP. 50% chance to block 40 damage from basic attacks.

ul_battlefury.name: Battle Fury
ul_battlefury.description: Melee holders only: +35% attack damage, and attacks also hit a second enemy for 50%.

ul_euls.name: Eul's Scepter
ul_euls.description: Gains 20 mana every 3 seconds. Every 10 seconds, the next enemy that attacks the holder is lifted into the air for 2.5 seconds.

ul_madness.name: Mask of Madness
ul_madness.description: +50% attack speed and heals for 15% of damage dealt, but the holder cannot cast.

ul_necro.name: Necronomicon
ul_necro.description: Each cast summons a Brill Bruiser (up to 2 at once).

ul_pipe.name: Pipe of Insight
ul_pipe.description: +40 magic resist. After 3 seconds, allies within 2 hexes gain a 250 shield.

ul_silveredge.name: Silver Edge
ul_silveredge.description: +25% attack speed and +300 max HP. Every 5 seconds, an attack makes the target deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

ul_basher.name: Skull Basher
ul_basher.description: +20% attack damage. Attacks have a 25% chance to deal 100 bonus damage and stun for 1.5 seconds (2 second cooldown).

ul_shako.name: Witless Shako
ul_shako.description: +1000 max HP, but the holder needs twice as much mana to cast.

ul_hat_antlers.name: Crown of Antlers
ul_hat_antlers.description: The holder joins the Hunters alliance.

ul_hat_fedora.name: Leg Breaker's Fedora
ul_hat_fedora.description: The holder joins the Oni alliance.

ul_hat_pirate.name: Pirate Hat
ul_hat_pirate.description: The holder joins the Blademasters alliance.

ul_hat_circlet.name: Ristul Circlet
ul_hat_circlet.description: The holder joins the Demon Lords alliance.

ul_bkb.name: Black King Bar
ul_bkb.description: +30% attack damage. Immune to stuns for the first 10 seconds.

ul_butterfly.name: Butterfly
ul_butterfly.description: +25% attack damage, +30% attack speed and 30% dodge chance.

ul_dagon.name: Dagon
ul_dagon.description: Every 12 seconds, deals 600 magic damage to a random enemy at or below 50% HP.

ul_diffusal.name: Diffusal Blade
ul_diffusal.description: Attacks burn 15 mana and deal 30 bonus damage.

ul_skadi.name: Eye of Skadi
ul_skadi.description: +550 max HP. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

ul_kaden.name: Kaden's Blade
ul_kaden.description: Attacks deal half their normal damage, plus 6% of the target's max HP as true damage.

ul_maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
ul_maelstrom.description: Attacks have a 25% chance to send chain lightning to 4 enemies for 110 magic damage (more against summons).

ul_mekansm.name: Mekansm
ul_mekansm.description: The first time the holder drops below 50% HP, allies within 3 hexes heal 500.

ul_mkb.name: Monkey King Bar
ul_mkb.description: +50% attack damage and +15% critical strike chance.

ul_refresher.name: Refresher Orb
ul_refresher.description: After its first cast, the holder's mana is refilled once.

ul_vyse.name: Scythe of Vyse
ul_vyse.description: Gains 20 mana every 3 seconds. Every 15 seconds, the next enemy that damages the holder is hexed (stunned) for 2.5 seconds.

ul_hat_ogre.name: Ogre Cap
ul_hat_ogre.description: The holder joins the Jungle Troopers alliance.

ul_hat_mantle.name: Mantle of the Flayed Twins
ul_hat_mantle.description: The holder joins the Nightmare Soldiers alliance.

ul_bloodthorn.name: Bloodthorn
ul_bloodthorn.description: +45% attack damage. Every 10 seconds, silences the enemy with the most mana for 4 seconds; attacks on silenced enemies deal 40% more damage.

ul_rapier.name: Divine Rapier
ul_rapier.description: +150% attack damage. If you lose a round against a player while it is on your board, that player takes it.

ul_tarrasque.name: Heart of Tarrasque
ul_tarrasque.description: +1200 max HP. Regenerates 2% of max HP per second.

ul_horn.name: Horn of the Alpha
ul_horn.description: 2 seconds into combat, a Thunderhide joins your team.

ul_radiance.name: Radiance
ul_radiance.description: Every second, deals 50 magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes; each has a 17% chance to miss its next attack.

ul_satanic.name: Satanic
ul_satanic.description: +750 max HP. Below 50% HP, heals for 150% of damage dealt for 3 seconds (10 second cooldown).

ul_shiva.name: Shiva's Guard
ul_shiva.description: +30 armor. 2 seconds into combat, deals 250 magic damage to enemies within 3 hexes and slows their attack speed by 40% for 4 seconds.

ul_vesture.name: Vesture of the Tyrant
ul_vesture.description: Allies within 1 hex at the start of combat survive for 6 more seconds after a killing blow (once each).

ul_vladmir.name: Vladmir's Offering
ul_vladmir.description: Allies within 2 hexes at the start of combat deal 8% more damage, gain 15 armor and heal for 10% of damage dealt.

ul_g_riches.name: Embarrassment of Riches
ul_g_riches.description: Your item picks show 4 choices instead of 3.

ul_g_silver.name: Silver Lining
ul_g_silver.description: Each win stores a charge (up to 3). Each loss with a charge spends it for 2 gold.

ul_g_aegis.name: Aegis of the Immortal
ul_g_aegis.description: The first time a loss would knock you out, you take no damage instead. Then the Aegis breaks.

ul_g_stone.name: Summoning Stone
ul_g_stone.description: Your summoned units gain 30% max HP and 30% attack speed.

ul_g_vicious.name: Vicious Intent
ul_g_vicious.description: When you beat a player, they lose 1 more HP for each of your surviving units.

ul_g_ristul.name: Dawning of Ristul
ul_g_ristul.description: In your combats, all healing on both teams is cut by 40%.

ul_g_assault.name: Coordinated Assault
ul_g_assault.description: Your Jungle Troopers give 25% attack speed to allies next to them.

ul_g_chivalry.name: Age of Chivalry
ul_g_chivalry.description: Your non-Knight units take 10% less damage for each allied Knight next to them.

ul_g_smuggler.name: Smuggler
ul_g_smuggler.description: Your item picks come from one tier higher.

ul_g_criminal.name: A Higher Class of Criminal
ul_g_criminal.description: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher.

SHINOBI.name: Shinobi
SHINOBI.description: Shinobi leap to the enemy back line. They gain a chance to land a critical hit; a critical hit wounds the target (healing on it is cut).

BEAST.name: Beast Kings
BEAST.description: Beast Kings gain max HP, plus more for every knockout scored by your Beast Kings this game (multiplied by their star level).

ONI.name: Oni
ONI.description: Oni attacks weaken the target: it deals less damage for 4 seconds. The first hit of the weakening deals bonus magic damage.

LEGEND.name: Legend
LEGEND.description: A Legend counts as a member of every alliance active on your team, and gains 3% damage and 8% max HP for each active alliance.

DEMON.name: Demon Lords
DEMON.description: When a Demon Lord casts, your other Demon Lords are silenced for 2.5 seconds and the caster deals 50% more damage for each of your living Demon Lords for 4 seconds.

DRAGON.name: Dragon's Roar
DRAGON.description: Dragon's Roar Digimon unlock their draconic power: +15 ability power, their abilities burn, and they splash 40% of their damage onto enemies next to the target.

UNDEAD.name: Undead
UNDEAD.description: The first time each Undead Digimon falls, allies within 2 hexes heal and deal 6% more damage for the rest of combat. With 6, each Undead also rises again once with 40% HP.

HOLY.name: Holy Healers
HOLY.description: All healing on your team is stronger.

PARTNER.name: Partners
PARTNER.description: Partner Digimon fight beside their humans: all allies generate mana every second.

HUNTER.name: Hunters
HUNTER.description: Hunters have a chance to quickly attack again (twice more with 6).

KNIGHT.name: Knights
KNIGHT.description: Knights take less damage, and that much less again while standing next to another Knight.

WIZARD.name: Wizards
WIZARD.description: Enemies take more magic damage from your team.

SAGE.name: Sage
SAGE.description: Once per combat, when a Sage drops below 50% HP, it becomes invulnerable but cannot act for 3 seconds.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.description: Toxic attacks poison the target. Each poison stack deals 4 magic damage per second and slows attack speed by 4% (up to 10 stacks, 6 seconds).

ROGUE.name: Rogues
ROGUE.description: Rogues evade basic attacks. Each evaded attack gives the Rogue attack damage for the rest of combat.

NATURE.name: Nature Spirits
NATURE.description: Each landed attack gives attack damage for the rest of combat: Nature Spirits only, then also your summons (4), then every ally (6).

SHAMAN.name: Shamans
SHAMAN.description: At the start of combat a beast joins your team: a wolf, then a wildwing (4), then a black dragon (6).

SPIRIT.name: Legendary Spirits
SPIRIT.description: When a Spirit casts it becomes charged. Once 3 Spirits are charged they strike together: magic damage and a short stun to every enemy near the middle of the three (more at higher stars).

SUMMONER.name: Summoners
SUMMONER.description: Your summoned units deal more damage.

BLADE.name: Blademasters
BLADE.description: Blademasters deal more damage for each enemy next to them.

JUNGLE.name: Jungle Troopers
JUNGLE.description: Jungle Troopers gain attack speed, and your other allies gain half as much.

WIND.name: Wind Guardians
WIND.description: When an enemy casts, your Wind Guardians (every ally with 4) in range switch to it, and their next attack on it deals bonus damage.

DARK.name: Dark Area
DARK.description: Every ally's attacks have a 25% chance to deal 1% of the target's max HP as true damage (once every 0.5 s per ally).

trait:BEAST:0.description: +200 HP, +6 HP per knockout (x star level)

trait:BEAST:1.description: +450 HP, +12 HP per knockout (x star level)

trait:LEGEND:0.description: all alliances, +3% damage and +8% HP per alliance

trait:DEMON:0.description: +50% damage per Demon Lord after casting

trait:PARTNER:0.description: +2 mana per second to all allies

trait:PARTNER:1.description: +4 mana per second to all allies

trait:PARTNER:2.description: +7 mana per second to all allies

trait:SPIRIT:0.description: Delta strike: 130 x star per Spirit

trait:WIND:0.description: Wind Guardians focus casters, +40% next hit

trait:WIND:1.description: all allies focus casters, +50% next hit

ability:ul_antimage:0.name: Little Horn
ability:ul_antimage:0.description: Mana Break (passive): attacks burn 10 mana and deal half of it as magic damage.

ability:ul_antimage:1.name: Howling Blaster
ability:ul_antimage:1.description: Mana Break (passive): attacks burn 20 mana and deal half of it as magic damage.

ability:ul_antimage:2.name: Cocytus Breath
ability:ul_antimage:2.description: Mana Break (passive): attacks burn 32 mana and deal half of it as magic damage. Burning the last of a target's mana deals 150 more damage.

ability:ul_batrider:0.name: Beak Pummel
ability:ul_batrider:0.description: Throws sticky oil: 110 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing them. Each cast adds 20 magic damage to his attacks (stacks 4 times).

ability:ul_batrider:1.name: Mach Shadow
ability:ul_batrider:1.description: Throws sticky oil: 187 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing them. Each cast adds 35 magic damage to his attacks (stacks 7 times).

ability:ul_batrider:2.name: Blast Wing
ability:ul_batrider:2.description: Throws sticky oil: 330 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing them. Each cast adds 55 magic damage to his attacks (stacks 10 times). The oil sets enemies on fire.

ability:ul_bounty:0.name: Electric Stun Blast
ability:ul_bounty:0.description: Hurls a shuriken for 240 magic damage and a short stun.

ability:ul_bounty:1.name: Musya Slash
ability:ul_bounty:1.description: Hurls a shuriken for 408 magic damage and a short stun.

ability:ul_bounty:2.name: Asura Fist
ability:ul_bounty:2.description: Hurls a shuriken for 720 magic damage and a short stun. Earns 1 gold for each enemy Digimon he knocks out.

ability:ul_crystal:0.name: Ice Prism
ability:ul_crystal:0.description: Freezes the target for 1.5 s, dealing 55 magic damage per second; it heals less meanwhile.

ability:ul_crystal:1.name: Iceball Bomb
ability:ul_crystal:1.description: Freezes the target for 2 s, dealing 94 magic damage per second; it heals less meanwhile.

ability:ul_crystal:2.name: Thousand Fists
ability:ul_crystal:2.description: Freezes the target for 2.5 s, dealing 165 magic damage per second; it heals less meanwhile. While she lives, allies gain 3 extra mana every second.

ability:ul_dazzle:0.name: Nemesis Ivy
ability:ul_dazzle:0.description: Heals up to 3 hurt allies and himself for 60; enemies next to each healed ally take 36 magic damage.

ability:ul_dazzle:1.name: Hazard Breath
ability:ul_dazzle:1.description: Heals up to 4 hurt allies and himself for 102; enemies next to each healed ally take 61 magic damage.

ability:ul_dazzle:2.name: Serpent Cure
ability:ul_dazzle:2.description: Heals up to 5 hurt allies and himself for 180; enemies next to each healed ally take 108 magic damage. Allies next to him start combat with a Shallow Grave: they survive 5 s after a killing blow.

ability:ul_drow:0.name: Downward Cleave
ability:ul_drow:0.description: Precision Aura (passive): allies next to her at the start of combat attack 10% faster.

ability:ul_drow:1.name: Kunai Wing
ability:ul_drow:1.description: Precision Aura (passive): allies next to her at the start of combat attack 20% faster.

ability:ul_drow:2.name: Aurvandil's Arrow
ability:ul_drow:2.description: Precision Aura (passive): allies next to her at the start of combat attack 30% faster. Frost Arrows: her attacks slow the target's attack speed by 20%.

ability:ul_enchantress:0.name: Rain of Pollen
ability:ul_enchantress:0.description: Wisps heal all allies within 4 hexes for 22 every 1.5 s for 11 s.

ability:ul_enchantress:1.name: Pummel Peck
ability:ul_enchantress:1.description: Wisps heal all allies within 4 hexes for 37 every 1.5 s for 11 s.

ability:ul_enchantress:2.name: Spiral Flower
ability:ul_enchantress:2.description: Wisps heal all allies within 4 hexes for 66 every 1.5 s for 11 s. Enemies attacking her have a 50% chance to attack much slower for a moment.

ability:ul_lich:0.name: Gamma Chill
ability:ul_lich:0.description: Gives a random ally a frost shield for 7 s: it takes 12% less damage and enemies within 2 hexes take 32 magic damage per second and attack slower.

ability:ul_lich:1.name: Zero Freeze
ability:ul_lich:1.description: Gives a random ally a frost shield for 7 s: it takes 18% less damage and enemies within 2 hexes take 54 magic damage per second and attack slower.

ability:ul_lich:2.name: Soul Chopper
ability:ul_lich:2.description: Gives a random ally a frost shield for 7 s: it takes 25% less damage and enemies within 2 hexes take 96 magic damage per second and attack slower. Also casts Chain Frost: an orb bounces 7 times for 150 magic damage, slowing.

ability:ul_magnus:0.name: Shell Guard
ability:ul_magnus:0.description: Empowers the ally with the most attack damage for 20 s: +15% damage and its attacks cleave 30%.

ability:ul_magnus:1.name: Guarding Tusk
ability:ul_magnus:1.description: Empowers the ally with the most attack damage for 20 s: +25% damage and its attacks cleave 50%.

ability:ul_magnus:2.name: Tusk Strikes
ability:ul_magnus:2.description: Empowers the ally with the most attack damage for 20 s: +40% damage and its attacks cleave 80%. Also Reverse Polarity: enemies within 2 hexes take 100 damage and are stunned for 1 s.

ability:ul_phantom:0.name: Colored Spark
ability:ul_phantom:0.description: Coup de Grace (passive): 15% chance to critically strike for 250% damage.

ability:ul_phantom:1.name: Dragon Wheel
ability:ul_phantom:1.description: Coup de Grace (passive): 20% chance to critically strike for 350% damage.

ability:ul_phantom:2.name: Illuminator
ability:ul_phantom:2.description: Coup de Grace (passive): 25% chance to critically strike for 450% damage. She also gains your active Rogue bonus.

ability:ul_shadowdemon:0.name: Bad Message
ability:ul_shadowdemon:0.description: Purges the target for 136 magic damage: for 5 s it attacks 50% slower and deals 20% less damage, then it takes 340 magic damage.

ability:ul_shadowdemon:1.name: Crimson Claw
ability:ul_shadowdemon:1.description: Purges the target for 231 magic damage: for 5 s it attacks 50% slower and deals 20% less damage, then it takes 578 magic damage.

ability:ul_shadowdemon:2.name: Skull Hammer
ability:ul_shadowdemon:2.description: Purges the target for 408 magic damage: for 5 s it attacks 50% slower and deals 20% less damage, then it takes 1020 magic damage. Soul Catcher: the target first loses 30% of its current HP and gets half back if it survives.

ability:ul_slardar:0.name: Water Pressure
ability:ul_slardar:0.description: Corrosive Haze: 130 magic damage, and the target loses 20 armor for 10 s.

ability:ul_slardar:1.name: Fossil Bite
ability:ul_slardar:1.description: Corrosive Haze: 221 magic damage, and the target loses 35 armor for 10 s.

ability:ul_slardar:2.name: Forbidden Trident
ability:ul_slardar:2.description: Corrosive Haze: 390 magic damage, and the target loses 55 armor for 10 s. Then bashes it for 100 damage and a 1.5 s stun.

ability:ul_snapfire:0.name: Fire Vortex
ability:ul_snapfire:0.description: Shotgun blast: 190 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing their attacks for 1 s.

ability:ul_snapfire:1.name: Flog Shot
ability:ul_snapfire:1.description: Shotgun blast: 323 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing their attacks for 2 s.

ability:ul_snapfire:2.name: Tenryu Slash
ability:ul_snapfire:2.description: Shotgun blast: 570 magic damage to the target and enemies next to it, slowing their attacks for 4 s. Also cuts their armor by 10.

ability:ul_tusk:0.name: Sharp Sider
ability:ul_tusk:0.description: Walrus Punch: a critical strike for 350% attack damage that stuns for 1 s and slows.

ability:ul_tusk:1.name: Harpoon Torpedo
ability:ul_tusk:1.description: Walrus Punch: a critical strike for 400% attack damage that stuns for 1 s and slows.

ability:ul_tusk:2.name: Vulcan's Hammer
ability:ul_tusk:2.description: Walrus Punch: a critical strike for 450% attack damage that stuns for 1.5 s and slows. The slow lasts longer and is stronger.

ability:ul_vengeful:0.name: Nightmare Syndrome
ability:ul_vengeful:0.description: Wave of Terror: 160 magic damage to every enemy in a line, cutting their armor by 10 for 6 s.

ability:ul_vengeful:1.name: Fire Phaser
ability:ul_vengeful:1.description: Wave of Terror: 272 magic damage to every enemy in a line, cutting their armor by 15 for 6 s.

ability:ul_vengeful:2.name: Eden's Javelin
ability:ul_vengeful:2.description: Wave of Terror: 480 magic damage to every enemy in a line, cutting their armor by 20 for 6 s. When she falls, enemies within 2 hexes take 300 damage.

ability:ul_venomancer:0.name: Fungus Crusher
ability:ul_venomancer:0.description: Summons a Plague Ward that poisons its targets.

ability:ul_venomancer:1.name: Sweet Breath
ability:ul_venomancer:1.description: Summons a Plague Ward that poisons its targets.

ability:ul_venomancer:2.name: Spider Thread
ability:ul_venomancer:2.description: Summons a Plague Ward that poisons its targets. Wards are immune to magic damage.

ability:ul_bristleback:0.name: Electric Thread
ability:ul_bristleback:0.description: Sprays quills at enemies within 2 hexes: 56 magic damage plus 30 per earlier quill hit on them this combat (up to 5).

ability:ul_bristleback:1.name: Brown Stingers
ability:ul_bristleback:1.description: Sprays quills at enemies within 2 hexes: 96 magic damage plus 32 per earlier quill hit on them this combat (up to 5).

ability:ul_bristleback:2.name: Mach Stinger V
ability:ul_bristleback:2.description: Sprays quills at enemies within 2 hexes: 169 magic damage plus 34 per earlier quill hit on them this combat (up to 5). Sprays automatically every 1.5 s.

ability:ul_chaosknight:0.name: Spitfire
ability:ul_chaosknight:0.description: Chaos Bolt: 188-376 magic damage and a 1-2 s stun.

ability:ul_chaosknight:1.name: Great Antler
ability:ul_chaosknight:1.description: Chaos Bolt: 319-638 magic damage and a 1.5-2.5 s stun.

ability:ul_chaosknight:2.name: Dark Destroyer
ability:ul_chaosknight:2.description: Chaos Bolt: 563-1126 magic damage and a 2-3 s stun. Your Knights always count as standing next to another Knight.

ability:ul_earthspirit:0.name: Vorvo Flame
ability:ul_earthspirit:0.description: Pulls a boulder through the target: 188 magic damage and 3 s silence to it and enemies next to it.

ability:ul_earthspirit:1.name: Lava Burst
ability:ul_earthspirit:1.description: Pulls a boulder through the target: 319 magic damage and 3 s silence to it and enemies next to it.

ability:ul_earthspirit:2.name: Volcanic Howl
ability:ul_earthspirit:2.description: Pulls a boulder through the target: 563 magic damage and 3 s silence to it and enemies next to it. Also stuns them for 1.5 s.

ability:ul_juggernaut:0.name: Meteor Slash
ability:ul_juggernaut:0.description: Blade Fury: spins for 5 s, immune to magic and stuns, dealing 88 magic damage per second to adjacent enemies.

ability:ul_juggernaut:1.name: Grade Slash
ability:ul_juggernaut:1.description: Blade Fury: spins for 5 s, immune to magic and stuns, dealing 149 magic damage per second to adjacent enemies.

ability:ul_juggernaut:2.name: Zanba Rend
ability:ul_juggernaut:2.description: Blade Fury: spins for 5 s, immune to magic and stuns, dealing 263 magic damage per second to adjacent enemies. While he lives, every ally gains 15% of his max HP.

ability:ul_kunkka:0.name: Scissors Execution
ability:ul_kunkka:0.description: Ghost Ship: crashes on the target, 88 magic damage and a 1 s stun to enemies within 2 hexes.

ability:ul_kunkka:1.name: Shell Rush
ability:ul_kunkka:1.description: Ghost Ship: crashes on the target, 149 magic damage and a 1.3 s stun to enemies within 2 hexes.

ability:ul_kunkka:2.name: Gate of Atlantis
ability:ul_kunkka:2.description: Ghost Ship: crashes on the target, 263 magic damage and a 1.7 s stun to enemies within 3 hexes. Every 4th attack swings for 150 bonus damage and cleaves 75%.

ability:ul_legion:0.name: Zuba Saber
ability:ul_legion:0.description: Duel: she and the weakest adjacent enemy must fight each other for 4 s, without casting or healing. If she wins, she keeps +6 attack damage for the rest of the game.

ability:ul_legion:1.name: Eager Slash
ability:ul_legion:1.description: Duel: she and the weakest adjacent enemy must fight each other for 4.75 s, without casting or healing. If she wins, she keeps +10 attack damage for the rest of the game.

ability:ul_legion:2.name: Durandal
ability:ul_legion:2.description: Duel: she and the weakest adjacent enemy must fight each other for 5.5 s, without casting or healing. If she wins, she keeps +15 attack damage for the rest of the game. Other enemies attacking her pick new targets.

ability:ul_luna:0.name: Bunny Blast

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

ul_anessa_dark.name: Anessa: Dark Support
ul_anessa_dark.description: A Demon Archer fights beside her (it falls when she does). She does not attack. Every 8 s your team gains 40-55% attack damage for 6 s. Every 8 s she marks the nearest enemy (-30 armor, your team focuses it); if it falls while marked, it rises to fight for you. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_anessa_heal.name: Anessa: Healing Support
ul_anessa_heal.description: A Demon Archer fights beside her (it falls when she does). She does not attack. Every 8 s she gives up 5% of her HP to heal your whole team at once and over 6 s. Every 15 s a Demonic Golem crashes down by the farthest enemy and stuns everything within 2 hexes. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_hob_fire.name: Hob: Fire Starter
ul_hob_fire.description: His attacks set enemies on fire. Every 12 s a fireball splits 640-1560 magic damage among the target and enemies next to it. Every 13 s his buddies throw 8 bombs. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_hob_crazy.name: Hob: Fire Support
ul_hob_crazy.description: His attacks set enemies on fire. Every 12 s a fireball splits 420-1120 damage among the target and its neighbors and stuns them. Every 10 s he goes crazy: for 6 s he can hit anything on the board and your team gains 30-90% attack speed. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_jules_brawl.name: Jules: Aggressive Tank
ul_jules_brawl.description: Gains 10 armor and magic resist for each unit next to him, friend or enemy. Every 8 s he heals 10% of his HP, draws nearby enemies to him and, for 5 s, takes 50% less damage, attacks twice as fast and heals from his hits. Every 12 s barrels roll in: 4 allies gain attack speed and 4 enemies take 25% more damage for the rest of combat. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_jules_bar.name: Jules: Healing Tank
ul_jules_bar.description: Gains 10 armor and magic resist for each unit next to him, friend or enemy. Every 10 s he takes 50% less damage for 5 s, and allies next to him heal for the damage he takes. Every 10 s Happy Hour: for 7 s your team takes half of each hit now and the rest over 10 s. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_enno_balm.name: Enno: Healin' N' Stealin'
ul_enno_balm.description: Escape Artist: the first time he drops below 50% HP (and 25% from rank 4) he vanishes in smoke, shakes off stuns and burns, lands elsewhere and stuns enemies next to him. Every 3 s he throws poison darts at 3-5 enemies within 3 hexes, and each hit heals your most hurt allies a little. At the start of combat he steals the stats of the enemy's lowest-tier item for one of your Digimon. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_enno_rabid.name: Enno: Rabid Furball
ul_enno_rabid.description: Escape Artist: the first time he drops below 50% HP (and 25% from rank 4) he vanishes in smoke, shakes off stuns and burns, lands elsewhere and stuns enemies next to him. Every 3 s poison darts hit 3-5 enemies within 3 hexes for damage per poison stack. Every 10 s All Out Attack: every enemy gains 3 poison stacks, takes damage and is stunned for 1.1 s. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

offer:ul_tamer.name: Pick your Tamer
offer:ul_tamer.description: Your Tamer stands on the board, uses abilities on cooldowns and ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_headdress.name: Headdress
ul_headdress.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it regenerate 20 HP per second.

ul_hood.name: Hood of Defiance
ul_hood.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it gain 25 magic resist.

ul_vitality.name: Vitality Booster
ul_vitality.description: The holder and the allies left and right of it gain 200 max HP.

ul_arcane.name: Arcane Boots
ul_arcane.description: Every 10 seconds, if the holder has over half its mana, allies within 2 hexes gain 20 mana.

ul_armlet.name: Armlet of Mordiggian
ul_armlet.description: +60% attack damage and +25 armor. The holder loses 3% of its max HP every second (it cannot fall below 1 HP from this).

ul_blademail.name: Blade Mail
ul_blademail.description: +15 armor. Returns 20% of damage taken to the attacker.

ul_blink.name: Blink Dagger
ul_blink.description: At the start of combat and every 15 seconds, teleports next to the farthest enemy and gains 45 mana.

ul_desolator.name: Desolator
ul_desolator.description: +10% attack damage. Attacks cut the target's armor by 15 for 5 seconds.

ul_lance.name: Dragon Lance
ul_lance.description: Ranged holders only: +25% attack damage and 3 more range.

ul_halberd.name: Heaven's Halberd
ul_halberd.description: 20% dodge chance. Every 10 seconds, an attack slows the target's attack speed by 60% for 3 seconds.

ul_paladin.name: Paladin Sword
ul_paladin.description: +20% attack damage. All healing on your team is 20% stronger.

ul_quelling.name: Quelling Blade
ul_quelling.description: +20% attack damage. Deals double damage to summoned units.

ul_stonecloak.name: Stonehall Cloak
ul_stonecloak.description: +150 max HP. Each knockout gives 100 max HP and heals 100 for the rest of combat.

ul_stonepike.name: Stonehall Pike
ul_stonepike.description: +10% attack damage. Each knockout gives 10% attack damage for the rest of combat.

ul_vanguard.name: Vanguard
ul_vanguard.description: +350 max HP. 50% chance to block 40 damage from basic attacks.

ul_battlefury.name: Battle Fury
ul_battlefury.description: Melee holders only: +35% attack damage, and attacks also hit a second enemy for 50%.

ul_euls.name: Eul's Scepter
ul_euls.description: Gains 20 mana every 3 seconds. Every 10 seconds, the next enemy that attacks the holder is lifted into the air for 2.5 seconds.

ul_madness.name: Mask of Madness
ul_madness.description: +50% attack speed and heals for 15% of damage dealt, but the holder cannot cast.

ul_necro.name: Necronomicon
ul_necro.description: Each cast summons a Brill Bruiser (up to 2 at once).

ul_pipe.name: Pipe of Insight
ul_pipe.description: +40 magic resist. After 3 seconds, allies within 2 hexes gain a 250 shield.

ul_silveredge.name: Silver Edge
ul_silveredge.description: +25% attack speed and +300 max HP. Every 5 seconds, an attack makes the target deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

ul_basher.name: Skull Basher
ul_basher.description: +20% attack damage. Attacks have a 25% chance to deal 100 bonus damage and stun for 1.5 seconds (2 second cooldown).

ul_shako.name: Witless Shako
ul_shako.description: +1000 max HP, but the holder needs twice as much mana to cast.

ul_hat_antlers.name: Crown of Antlers
ul_hat_antlers.description: The holder joins the Hunters alliance.

ul_hat_fedora.name: Leg Breaker's Fedora
ul_hat_fedora.description: The holder joins the Oni alliance.

ul_hat_pirate.name: Pirate Hat
ul_hat_pirate.description: The holder joins the Blademasters alliance.

ul_hat_circlet.name: Ristul Circlet
ul_hat_circlet.description: The holder joins the Demon Lords alliance.

ul_bkb.name: Black King Bar
ul_bkb.description: +30% attack damage. Immune to stuns for the first 10 seconds.

ul_butterfly.name: Butterfly
ul_butterfly.description: +25% attack damage, +30% attack speed and 30% dodge chance.

ul_dagon.name: Dagon
ul_dagon.description: Every 12 seconds, deals 600 magic damage to a random enemy at or below 50% HP.

ul_diffusal.name: Diffusal Blade
ul_diffusal.description: Attacks burn 15 mana and deal 30 bonus damage.

ul_skadi.name: Eye of Skadi
ul_skadi.description: +550 max HP. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

ul_kaden.name: Kaden's Blade
ul_kaden.description: Attacks deal half their normal damage, plus 6% of the target's max HP as true damage.

ul_maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
ul_maelstrom.description: Attacks have a 25% chance to send chain lightning to 4 enemies for 110 magic damage (more against summons).

ul_mekansm.name: Mekansm
ul_mekansm.description: The first time the holder drops below 50% HP, allies within 3 hexes heal 500.

ul_mkb.name: Monkey King Bar
ul_mkb.description: +50% attack damage and +15% critical strike chance.

ul_refresher.name: Refresher Orb
ul_refresher.description: After its first cast, the holder's mana is refilled once.

ul_vyse.name: Scythe of Vyse
ul_vyse.description: Gains 20 mana every 3 seconds. Every 15 seconds, the next enemy that damages the holder is hexed (stunned) for 2.5 seconds.

ul_hat_ogre.name: Ogre Cap
ul_hat_ogre.description: The holder joins the Jungle Troopers alliance.

ul_hat_mantle.name: Mantle of the Flayed Twins
ul_hat_mantle.description: The holder joins the Nightmare Soldiers alliance.

ul_bloodthorn.name: Bloodthorn
ul_bloodthorn.description: +45% attack damage. Every 10 seconds, silences the enemy with the most mana for 4 seconds; attacks on silenced enemies deal 40% more damage.

ul_rapier.name: Divine Rapier
ul_rapier.description: +150% attack damage. If you lose a round against a player while it is on your board, that player takes it.

ul_tarrasque.name: Heart of Tarrasque
ul_tarrasque.description: +1200 max HP. Regenerates 2% of max HP per second.

ul_horn.name: Horn of the Alpha
ul_horn.description: 2 seconds into combat, a Thunderhide joins your team.

ul_radiance.name: Radiance
ul_radiance.description: Every second, deals 50 magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes; each has a 17% chance to miss its next attack.

ul_satanic.name: Satanic
ul_satanic.description: +750 max HP. Below 50% HP, heals for 150% of damage dealt for 3 seconds (10 second cooldown).

ul_shiva.name: Shiva's Guard
ul_shiva.description: +30 armor. 2 seconds into combat, deals 250 magic damage to enemies within 3 hexes and slows their attack speed by 40% for 4 seconds.

ul_vesture.name: Vesture of the Tyrant
ul_vesture.description: Allies within 1 hex at the start of combat survive for 6 more seconds after a killing blow (once each).

ul_vladmir.name: Vladmir's Offering
ul_vladmir.description: Allies within 2 hexes at the start of combat deal 8% more damage, gain 15 armor and heal for 10% of damage dealt.

ul_g_riches.name: Embarrassment of Riches
ul_g_riches.description: Your item picks show 4 choices instead of 3.

ul_g_silver.name: Silver Lining
ul_g_silver.description: Each win stores a charge (up to 3). Each loss with a charge spends it for 2 gold.

ul_g_aegis.name: Aegis of the Immortal
ul_g_aegis.description: The first time a loss would knock you out, you take no damage instead. Then the Aegis breaks.

ul_g_stone.name: Summoning Stone
ul_g_stone.description: Your summoned units gain 30% max HP and 30% attack speed.

ul_g_vicious.name: Vicious Intent
ul_g_vicious.description: When you beat a player, they lose 1 more HP for each of your surviving units.

ul_g_ristul.name: Dawning of Ristul
ul_g_ristul.description: In your combats, all healing on both teams is cut by 40%.

ul_g_assault.name: Coordinated Assault
ul_g_assault.description: Your Jungle Troopers give 25% attack speed to allies next to them.

ul_g_chivalry.name: Age of Chivalry
ul_g_chivalry.description: Your non-Knight units take 10% less damage for each allied Knight next to them.

ul_g_smuggler.name: Smuggler
ul_g_smuggler.description: Your item picks come from one tier higher.

ul_g_criminal.name: A Higher Class of Criminal
ul_g_criminal.description: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher.

SHINOBI.name: Shinobi
SHINOBI.description: Shinobi leap to the enemy back line. They gain a chance to land a critical hit; a critical hit wounds the target (healing on it is cut).

BEAST.name: Beast Kings
BEAST.description: Beast Kings gain max HP, plus more for every knockout scored by your Beast Kings this game (multiplied by their star level).

ONI.name: Oni
ONI.description: Oni attacks weaken the target: it deals less damage for 4 seconds. The first hit of the weakening deals bonus magic damage.

LEGEND.name: Legend
LEGEND.description: A Legend counts as a member of every alliance active on your team, and gains 3% damage and 8% max HP for each active alliance.

DEMON.name: Demon Lords
DEMON.description: When a Demon Lord casts, your other Demon Lords are silenced for 2.5 seconds and the caster deals 50% more damage for each of your living Demon Lords for 4 seconds.

DRAGON.name: Dragon's Roar
DRAGON.description: Dragon's Roar Digimon unlock their draconic power: +15 ability power, their abilities burn, and they splash 40% of their damage onto enemies next to the target.

UNDEAD.name: Undead
UNDEAD.description: The first time each Undead Digimon falls, allies within 2 hexes heal and deal 6% more damage for the rest of combat. With 6, each Undead also rises again once with 40% HP.

HOLY.name: Holy Healers
HOLY.description: All healing on your team is stronger.

PARTNER.name: Partners
PARTNER.description: Partner Digimon fight beside their humans: all allies generate mana every second.

HUNTER.name: Hunters
HUNTER.description: Hunters have a chance to quickly attack again (twice more with 6).

KNIGHT.name: Knights
KNIGHT.description: Knights take less damage, and that much less again while standing next to another Knight.

WIZARD.name: Wizards
WIZARD.description: Enemies take more magic damage from your team.

SAGE.name: Sage
SAGE.description: Once per combat, when a Sage drops below 50% HP, it becomes invulnerable but cannot act for 3 seconds.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.description: Toxic attacks poison the target. Each poison stack deals 4 magic damage per second and slows attack speed by 4% (up to 10 stacks, 6 seconds).

ROGUE.name: Rogues
ROGUE.description: Rogues evade basic attacks. Each evaded attack gives the Rogue attack damage for the rest of combat.

NATURE.name: Nature Spirits
NATURE.description: Each landed attack gives attack damage for the rest of combat: Nature Spirits only, then also your summons (4), then every ally (6).

SHAMAN.name: Shamans
SHAMAN.description: At the start of combat a beast joins your team: a wolf, then a wildwing (4), then a black dragon (6).

SPIRIT.name: Legendary Spirits
SPIRIT.description: When a Spirit casts it becomes charged. Once 3 Spirits are charged they strike together: magic damage and a short stun to every enemy near the middle of the three (more at higher stars).

SUMMONER.name: Summoners
SUMMONER.description: Your summoned units deal more damage.

BLADE.name: Blademasters
BLADE.description: Blademasters deal more damage for each enemy next to them.

JUNGLE.name: Jungle Troopers
JUNGLE.description: Jungle Troopers gain attack speed, and your other allies gain half as much.

WIND.name: Wind Guardians
WIND.description: When an enemy casts, your Wind Guardians (every ally with 4) in range switch to it, and their next attack on it deals bonus damage.

DARK.name: Dark Area
DARK.description: Every ally's attacks have a 25% chance to deal 1% of the target's max HP as true damage (once every 0.5 s per ally).

ability:ul_venomancer:1.description: Summons a Plague Ward that poisons its targets.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

ul_anessa_dark.name: Anessa: Dark Support
ul_anessa_dark.description: A Demon Archer fights beside her (it falls when she does). She does not attack. Every 8 s your team gains 40-55% attack damage for 6 s. Every 8 s she marks the nearest enemy (-30 armor, your team focuses it); if it falls while marked, it rises to fight for you. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_anessa_heal.name: Anessa: Healing Support
ul_anessa_heal.description: A Demon Archer fights beside her (it falls when she does). She does not attack. Every 8 s she gives up 5% of her HP to heal your whole team at once and over 6 s. Every 15 s a Demonic Golem crashes down by the farthest enemy and stuns everything within 2 hexes. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_hob_fire.name: Hob: Fire Starter
ul_hob_fire.description: His attacks set enemies on fire. Every 12 s a fireball splits 640-1560 magic damage among the target and enemies next to it. Every 13 s his buddies throw 8 bombs. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_hob_crazy.name: Hob: Fire Support
ul_hob_crazy.description: His attacks set enemies on fire. Every 12 s a fireball splits 420-1120 damage among the target and its neighbors and stuns them. Every 10 s he goes crazy: for 6 s he can hit anything on the board and your team gains 30-90% attack speed. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_jules_brawl.name: Jules: Aggressive Tank
ul_jules_brawl.description: Gains 10 armor and magic resist for each unit next to him, friend or enemy. Every 8 s he heals 10% of his HP, draws nearby enemies to him and, for 5 s, takes 50% less damage, attacks twice as fast and heals from his hits. Every 12 s barrels roll in: 4 allies gain attack speed and 4 enemies take 25% more damage for the rest of combat. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_jules_bar.name: Jules: Healing Tank
ul_jules_bar.description: Gains 10 armor and magic resist for each unit next to him, friend or enemy. Every 10 s he takes 50% less damage for 5 s, and allies next to him heal for the damage he takes. Every 10 s Happy Hour: for 7 s your team takes half of each hit now and the rest over 10 s. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_enno_balm.name: Enno: Healin' N' Stealin'
ul_enno_balm.description: Escape Artist: the first time he drops below 50% HP (and 25% from rank 4) he vanishes in smoke, shakes off stuns and burns, lands elsewhere and stuns enemies next to him. Every 3 s he throws poison darts at 3-5 enemies within 3 hexes, and each hit heals your most hurt allies a little. At the start of combat he steals the stats of the enemy's lowest-tier item for one of your Digimon. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

ul_enno_rabid.name: Enno: Rabid Furball
ul_enno_rabid.description: Escape Artist: the first time he drops below 50% HP (and 25% from rank 4) he vanishes in smoke, shakes off stuns and burns, lands elsewhere and stuns enemies next to him. Every 3 s poison darts hit 3-5 enemies within 3 hexes for damage per poison stack. Every 10 s All Out Attack: every enemy gains 3 poison stacks, takes damage and is stunned for 1.1 s. Ranks up every 5 rounds.

offer:ul_tamer.name: Pick your Tamer
offer:ul_tamer.description: Your Tamer stands on the board, uses abilities on cooldowns and ranks up every 5 rounds.

ac_grand_claw.name: Grand Claw
ac_grand_claw.description: +25% crit chance, critical strikes deal 60% more. (Daedalus)

ac_thunder_disk.name: Thunder Disk
ac_thunder_disk.description: Every third attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 70 magic damage. (Maelstrom)

ac_thunder_hammer.name: Thunder Hammer
ac_thunder_hammer.description: Every third attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 140 magic damage. (Mjollnir)

ac_berserk_mask.name: Berserk Mask
ac_berserk_mask.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking. (Mask of Madness)

ac_fury_axe.name: Fury Axe
ac_fury_axe.description: Regenerates 1.2% HP/s. Attacks also hit a second enemy for 50%. (Battle Fury)

ac_corrosion_blade.name: Corrosion Blade
ac_corrosion_blade.description: Attacks cut the target armor by 35% for 3 s. (Desolator)

ac_black_gear.name: Black Gear
ac_black_gear.description: Immune to stuns for the first 12 seconds. (Black King Bar)

ac_digicore.name: Digicore
ac_digicore.description: +300 more max HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. (Heart of Tarrasque)

ac_digizoid_armor.name: Chrome Digizoid Armor
ac_digizoid_armor.description: At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes gain 20 armor and 15% attack speed; enemies within 3 hexes lose 20 armor. (Assault Cuirass)

ac_reflect_mail.name: Reflect Mail
ac_reflect_mail.description: Returns 30% of physical damage taken to the attacker as magic damage. (Blade Mail)

ac_refresh_disk.name: Refresh Disk
ac_refresh_disk.description: After the first cast each combat, mana refills at once. (Refresher Orb)

ac_data_hood.name: Data Hood
ac_data_hood.description: +15 more magic resist. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. (Hood of Defiance)

ac_numemon_wand.name: Numemon Wand
ac_numemon_wand.description: Every 7 s, turns the costliest enemy into a Numemon: it cannot act for 2.5 s. (Scythe of Vyse)

ac_true_lance.name: True Strike Lance
ac_true_lance.description: Attacks deal 60 bonus magic damage. (Monkey King Bar)

ac_hellfire_rod.name: Hellfire Rod
ac_hellfire_rod.description: Every 6 s, deals 250 magic damage to a random enemy. (Dagon)

ac_mystic_staff.name: Mystic Staff
ac_mystic_staff.description: +40 more AP. Abilities can critically strike. (Mystic Staff)

ac_sage_orb.name: Sage Orb
ac_sage_orb.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and magic resist. (Kaya)

ac_steady_disk.name: Steady Disk
ac_steady_disk.description: Regenerates 1.2% HP/s. Attacks restore 5 more mana. (Perseverance)

ac_stun_hammer.name: Stun Hammer
ac_stun_hammer.description: Attacks have a 15% chance to stun the target for 1.2 s. (Skull Basher)

ac_frost_ring.name: Frost Ring
ac_frost_ring.description: Attacks slow the target attack speed by 25% for 2 s. (Eye of Skadi)

ac_medical_kit.name: Medical Kit
ac_medical_kit.description: Every 5 s, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP. (Mekansm)

ac_radiant_crest.name: Radiant Crest
ac_radiant_crest.description: Every 2 s, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. (Radiance)

ac_dragon_lance.name: Dragon Lance
ac_dragon_lance.description: Ranged holders gain 1 attack range. (Dragon Lance)

ac_soul_disk.name: Soul Disk
ac_soul_disk.description: More health and starting mana. (Soul Booster)

ac_iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
ac_iron_helm.description: Takes 6% less damage. (Helm of Iron Will)

ac_ward_cape.name: Ward Cape
ac_ward_cape.description: At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes gain 25 magic resist. (Pipe of Insight)

ac_recovery_disk.name: Recovery Disk
ac_recovery_disk.description: Regenerate 1.2% max HP per second. (Ring of Health)

ac_digiegg.name: Digi-Egg
ac_digiegg.description: Wildcard. Drag onto a Rookie or Champion: it hatches into one more copy of that Digimon, which counts toward digivolving. Needs a copy left in the shared pool.

ac_r_forge.name: Weaponsmith's Forge
ac_r_forge.description: Gain a random finished item now.

ac_r_vault.name: Great Vault
ac_r_vault.description: Interest cap rises from 5 to 8 gold.

ac_r_charm.name: Light and Shadow Charm
ac_r_charm.description: Win and loss streak gold is doubled.

ac_r_recruiter.name: Recruiter Badge
ac_r_recruiter.description: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher.

ac_r_grace.name: Grace of Nature
ac_r_grace.description: Your Digimon regenerate 1.2% max HP per second in combat.

ac_r_discount.name: Bargain Tag
ac_r_discount.description: Selling a Digimon pays 1 extra gold.

DRAGON.name: Dragon
DRAGON.description: Dragons start combat with most of their mana.

DEMON.name: Demon
DEMON.description: Works only while you field exactly one kind of Demon (two Demon Slayers lift this limit). Demon basic attacks deal extra true damage. An enemy Demon Slayer cancels it.

FAIRY.name: Fairy
FAIRY.description: Fairies gain a chance to dodge basic attacks.

HUMAN.name: Human
HUMAN.description: Basic attacks from Humans can silence the target for 3 seconds.

MACHINE.name: Machine
MACHINE.description: Nanobots: at 3, one random ally gains armor and regeneration. At 6, every ally does.

INSECT.name: Insect
INSECT.description: Insects gain attack speed. At 4, all allies gain attack speed too.

ELEMENTAL.name: Elemental
ELEMENTAL.description: Elementals gain armor and magic resist. When a melee attacker hits them, they can turn it to stone (stunned 1.5 s). At 4, every ally can.

CYBORG.name: Cyborg
CYBORG.description: Cyborgs gain 1 attack range and attack damage.

OLYMPOS.name: Olympos
OLYMPOS.description: Works only while no other race is active. All allies gain more mana per attack.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.description: Enemies take more magic damage from your team.

ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: Assassins leap to the back line and gain critical strikes.

KNIGHT.name: Knight
KNIGHT.description: When hit, Knights can raise a divine shield: 30% chance per level, each one cuts damage taken by 18% for 3 seconds. Shields stack.

DRUID.name: Druid
DRUID.description: Druids digivolve from 2 copies instead of 3. A Champion Druid fights at full strength only with 2 Druids, a final-form Druid only with 4; otherwise it fights as the lower form. Every 4 seconds each Druid heals the lowest-health ally.

SHAMAN.name: Shaman
SHAMAN.description: At the start of combat, a random enemy is hexed (cannot act) for a few seconds.

WARLOCK.name: Warlock
WARLOCK.description: All allies heal for part of the damage they deal.

DH.name: Demon Slayer
DH.description: Demon Slayers gain attack speed and deal more damage to Demons and cancel enemy Demon power. With 2, your Demons keep their power however many kinds you field.

PRIEST.name: Priest
PRIEST.description: Your Tamer takes less damage when you lose a round, and your team heals more.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD.description: Rule change: every other race and class that needs 4 or more units needs one fewer (for example Fairy 6 needs 5). Wizards also gain ability power.

duo_wide_portal.name: Wide Portal
duo_wide_portal.description: +1 portal send each round. Each Digimon or item you send also gives your partner 1 gold.

duo_proud.name: Proud Partner
duo_proud.description: Gain 2 gold whenever your partner digivolves a Digimon (up to 3 times a round).

duo_gear.name: Pass the Gear
duo_gear.description: Gain 2 random components. Your partner gains 1.

duo_interest.name: Shared Interest
duo_interest.description: Each round, gain 1 gold for every 10 gold your partner is holding (up to 3).

duo_care.name: Care Package
duo_care.description: At the start of every round, a random Digimon goes through the portal to your partner for free (1-2 cost early, up to 4 cost late).

duo_ace.name: Partner's Ace
duo_ace.description: Your Digimon gain 3% attack damage and 3 ability power for each gold your partner's most valuable Digimon is worth (cost x copies, up to 10).

duo_tag.name: Tag Team
duo_tag.description: In team fights, whenever one of your partner's Digimon is knocked out, your Digimon heal 10% of their max HP and gain 15% attack speed for 4 seconds.

duo_crest_link.name: Crest Link
duo_crest_link.description: Your Crests also count for your partner: in team fights, every trait your Crests add counts one more time for your team.

duo_guard.name: Team Guard
duo_guard.description: Your team loses 25% less HP from lost fights (rounded up). Two Team Guards do not stack.

duo_sync.name: Sync Bond
duo_sync.description: In team fights, every trait active on both your board and your partner's counts one more for your team. Your Digimon deal 8% more damage.

duo_trove.name: Shared Treasure
duo_trove.description: You and your partner each gain a random completed item and 5 gold.

offer:ac_loot.name: Creep Loot
offer:ac_loot.description: You beat the creeps. Pick one item for your item bench.

offer:ac_relic.name: Relic
offer:ac_relic.description: Pick one relic. It replaces the relic you hold.

ac_grand_claw.name: Grand Claw
ac_grand_claw.description: +25% crit chance, critical strikes deal 60% more. (Daedalus)

ac_thunder_disk.name: Thunder Disk
ac_thunder_disk.description: Every third attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 70 magic damage. (Maelstrom)

ac_thunder_hammer.name: Thunder Hammer
ac_thunder_hammer.description: Every third attack sends lightning to 3 enemies for 140 magic damage. (Mjollnir)

ac_berserk_mask.name: Berserk Mask
ac_berserk_mask.description: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking. (Mask of Madness)

ac_fury_axe.name: Fury Axe
ac_fury_axe.description: Regenerates 1.2% HP/s. Attacks also hit a second enemy for 50%. (Battle Fury)

ac_corrosion_blade.name: Corrosion Blade
ac_corrosion_blade.description: Attacks cut the target armor by 35% for 3 s. (Desolator)

ac_black_gear.name: Black Gear
ac_black_gear.description: Immune to stuns for the first 12 seconds. (Black King Bar)

ac_digicore.name: Digicore
ac_digicore.description: +300 more max HP. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. (Heart of Tarrasque)

ac_digizoid_armor.name: Chrome Digizoid Armor
ac_digizoid_armor.description: At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes gain 20 armor and 15% attack speed; enemies within 3 hexes lose 20 armor. (Assault Cuirass)

ac_reflect_mail.name: Reflect Mail
ac_reflect_mail.description: Returns 30% of physical damage taken to the attacker as magic damage. (Blade Mail)

ac_refresh_disk.name: Refresh Disk
ac_refresh_disk.description: After the first cast each combat, mana refills at once. (Refresher Orb)

ac_data_hood.name: Data Hood
ac_data_hood.description: +15 more magic resist. Regenerates 1% max HP per second. (Hood of Defiance)

ac_numemon_wand.name: Numemon Wand
ac_numemon_wand.description: Every 7 s, turns the costliest enemy into a Numemon: it cannot act for 2.5 s. (Scythe of Vyse)

ac_true_lance.name: True Strike Lance
ac_true_lance.description: Attacks deal 60 bonus magic damage. (Monkey King Bar)

ac_hellfire_rod.name: Hellfire Rod
ac_hellfire_rod.description: Every 6 s, deals 250 magic damage to a random enemy. (Dagon)

ac_mystic_staff.name: Mystic Staff
ac_mystic_staff.description: +40 more AP. Abilities can critically strike. (Mystic Staff)

ac_sage_orb.name: Sage Orb
ac_sage_orb.description: Enemies within 2 hexes lose 25 armor and magic resist. (Kaya)

ac_steady_disk.name: Steady Disk
ac_steady_disk.description: Regenerates 1.2% HP/s. Attacks restore 5 more mana. (Perseverance)

ac_stun_hammer.name: Stun Hammer
ac_stun_hammer.description: Attacks have a 15% chance to stun the target for 1.2 s. (Skull Basher)

ac_frost_ring.name: Frost Ring
ac_frost_ring.description: Attacks slow the target attack speed by 25% for 2 s. (Eye of Skadi)

ac_medical_kit.name: Medical Kit
ac_medical_kit.description: Every 5 s, heals allies within 2 hexes for 80 + 10% of missing HP. (Mekansm)

ac_radiant_crest.name: Radiant Crest
ac_radiant_crest.description: Every 2 s, burns the nearest enemy within 2 hexes. (Radiance)

ac_dragon_lance.name: Dragon Lance
ac_dragon_lance.description: Ranged holders gain 1 attack range. (Dragon Lance)

ac_soul_disk.name: Soul Disk
ac_soul_disk.description: More health and starting mana. (Soul Booster)

ac_iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
ac_iron_helm.description: Takes 6% less damage. (Helm of Iron Will)

ac_ward_cape.name: Ward Cape
ac_ward_cape.description: At the start of combat, allies within 2 hexes gain 25 magic resist. (Pipe of Insight)

ac_recovery_disk.name: Recovery Disk
ac_recovery_disk.description: Regenerate 1.2% max HP per second. (Ring of Health)

ac_digiegg.name: Digi-Egg
ac_digiegg.description: Wildcard. Drag onto a Rookie or Champion: it hatches into one more copy of that Digimon, which counts toward digivolving. Needs a copy left in the shared pool.

ac_r_forge.name: Weaponsmith's Forge
ac_r_forge.description: Gain a random finished item now.

ac_r_vault.name: Great Vault
ac_r_vault.description: Interest cap rises from 5 to 8 gold.

ac_r_charm.name: Light and Shadow Charm
ac_r_charm.description: Win and loss streak gold is doubled.

ac_r_recruiter.name: Recruiter Badge
ac_r_recruiter.description: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher.

ac_r_grace.name: Grace of Nature
ac_r_grace.description: Your Digimon regenerate 1.2% max HP per second in combat.

ac_r_discount.name: Bargain Tag
ac_r_discount.description: Selling a Digimon pays 1 extra gold.

consumable:ac_digiegg.name: Digi-Egg
consumable:ac_digiegg.description: Wildcard. Drag onto a Rookie or Champion: it hatches into one more copy of that Digimon, which counts toward digivolving. Needs a copy left in the shared pool.

DRAGON.name: Dragon
DRAGON.description: Dragons start combat with most of their mana.

DEMON.name: Demon
DEMON.description: Works only while you field exactly one kind of Demon (two Demon Slayers lift this limit). Demon basic attacks deal extra true damage. An enemy Demon Slayer cancels it.

FAIRY.name: Fairy
FAIRY.description: Fairies gain a chance to dodge basic attacks.

HUMAN.name: Human
HUMAN.description: Basic attacks from Humans can silence the target for 3 seconds.

MACHINE.name: Machine
MACHINE.description: Nanobots: at 3, one random ally gains armor and regeneration. At 6, every ally does.

INSECT.name: Insect
INSECT.description: Insects gain attack speed. At 4, all allies gain attack speed too.

ELEMENTAL.name: Elemental
ELEMENTAL.description: Elementals gain armor and magic resist. When a melee attacker hits them, they can turn it to stone (stunned 1.5 s). At 4, every ally can.

CYBORG.name: Cyborg
CYBORG.description: Cyborgs gain 1 attack range and attack damage.

OLYMPOS.name: Olympos
OLYMPOS.description: Works only while no other race is active. All allies gain more mana per attack.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.description: Enemies take more magic damage from your team.

ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: Assassins leap to the back line and gain critical strikes.

KNIGHT.name: Knight
KNIGHT.description: When hit, Knights can raise a divine shield: 30% chance per level, each one cuts damage taken by 18% for 3 seconds. Shields stack.

DRUID.name: Druid
DRUID.description: Druids digivolve from 2 copies instead of 3. A Champion Druid fights at full strength only with 2 Druids, a final-form Druid only with 4; otherwise it fights as the lower form. Every 4 seconds each Druid heals the lowest-health ally.

SHAMAN.name: Shaman
SHAMAN.description: At the start of combat, a random enemy is hexed (cannot act) for a few seconds.

WARLOCK.name: Warlock
WARLOCK.description: All allies heal for part of the damage they deal.

DH.name: Demon Slayer
DH.description: Demon Slayers gain attack speed and deal more damage to Demons and cancel enemy Demon power. With 2, your Demons keep their power however many kinds you field.

PRIEST.name: Priest
PRIEST.description: Your Tamer takes less damage when you lose a round, and your team heals more.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD.description: Rule change: every other race and class that needs 4 or more units needs one fewer (for example Fairy 6 needs 5). Wizards also gain ability power.
